raw.title: Project Launch Manager - Data Center Construction
raw.excerpt: Turner & Townsend is seeking Senior Consultants to join a new delivery launch services team supporting a confidential hyperscale data center client.
raw.description:
Turner & Townsend is seeking Senior Consultants to join a new delivery launch services team supporting a confidential hyperscale data center client. The role manages the transition of each signed deal from lease execution through to construction mobilization. The ideal individual will be experienced in preconstruction management, project handover, and stakeholder management on data center, mission critical, or comparable complex facilities.

Following lease execution, the Senior Consultant works with the pre-lease team to absorb and package the deal, completes the handover check against the client requirements, co-leads the project launch onsite with the client project lead, coordinates preconstruction as design detail matures, and drives open items to closure. Each site is handed to the onsite delivery team at construction mobilization, approximately ten weeks later.

This is a permanent position and deals cycle through it continuously, with two to three sites typically held at once at different stages. The role is paired with a client project lead on each site and works to the client standards for handover and reporting. Construction and preconstruction experience is directly relevant and welcome, but the role hands each site over at mobilization and is not a site-based construction management position.

The team is newly established, so early joiners will shape the standard the team applies rather than inherit it, and will see a high volume of sites and developer counterparties across the portfolio.

Three positions are available. San Francisco is preferred. Other locations and remote will be considered for the right candidate.

Responsibilities

  • Deal intake and handover check: Responsible for working with the pre-lease team to absorb and package each signed deal, for completing the handover check against the client requirements, and for ensuring every transfer item is either evidenced or logged as a gap with an assigned owner and resolution date.
  • Project launch: Responsible for preparing and co-leading the project launch meeting on the project site with the client project lead, including materials and briefing, and for assigning and tracking the resulting actions to completion.
  • Baseline coordination: Responsible for commissioning the schedule and cost reviews undertaken by dedicated specialists as design detail matures, for carrying their findings into the site baseline and reporting, and for pursuing the resulting actions with the developer. Cost scope applies on deals where the lease structure requires it.
  • Open item management: Responsible for driving all open items inherited from due diligence to documented closure within the launch window.
  • Preconstruction coordination: Responsible for the weekly project call, design coordination, and developer interface through to mobilization.
  • Reporting and tracking: Responsible for maintaining the action log and producing milestone reporting inputs to a consistent standard format across the portfolio.
  • Stakeholder management: Responsible for the day-to-day interface with the developer, the client project lead, and internal specialists, and for maintaining progress against agreed dates.
  • Handover to delivery: Responsible for transferring each site to the onsite delivery team at mobilization, including the current baseline, the open item register, and the record of risks accepted at signing.
  • Continuous improvement: Responsible for contributing to the development of the team handover check, launch format, and reporting standard, and for applying lessons learned to subsequent sites.

SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered

Project/Program Specifications:

  • Market sector experience: Data center delivery, preconstruction, or development, mission critical facilities, or complex technical buildings.
  • Project/program specific responsibilities: Managing the transition from lease execution to construction mobilization across a portfolio of sites, typically two to three at a time.
  • Software specific requirements: MS Suite and Google Workspace. General technological proficiency expected.
  • Travel: Approximately 6-10 days per month, including in-person launch meetings.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience. A degree is not required.
  • Data center experience preferred, in delivery, preconstruction, or development. Mission critical and complex technical facility backgrounds will be considered where the experience is transferable.
  • A working knowledge of data center construction, including the information and documentation an incoming delivery team requires at mobilization.
  • Experience of project handover, preconstruction coordination, change control, and open item tracking.
  • Able to interpret and act on schedule and cost reviews produced by specialists, and to pursue the resulting issues with a developer.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects at different stages, and to secure information and commitments from parties who do not report to the role.
  • Able to lead meetings with senior stakeholders and to secure assigned actions with owners and dates.
  • Able to work to a standard that is under development and to contribute to establishing it.
  • Have the technical skills to read, understand, and communicate contract requirements including construction drawings and specifications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including concise reporting to senior client stakeholders.
  • Technologically proficient, including MS Suite and Google Workspace.
  • Be able to understand and follow site HSSE policies.

The salary range for this full-time role is $140K-$160K per year. Ranges are determined by role and level and represent a good faith effort to provide a fair and equitable salary. This range is a reflection of base salary only, not of a total compensation package.  Please note Turner & Townsend reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range, depending on candidate’s experience and qualifications.

Qualified candidates with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with LA County ordinance and CA law.  

Turner & Townsend is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

raw.title: Soutien technique VoIP – Niveau 2 | VoIP Tier 2 Technical Support
raw.excerpt: Exigences du posteFormation et expérience• Plus de 2 ans d’expérience en soutien technique, opérations réseau ou soutien VoIP, incluant une expérience préalable en soutien de niveau 1.
raw.description:
Exigences du poste

Formation et expérience

  • Plus de 2 ans d’expérience en soutien technique, opérations réseau ou soutien VoIP, incluant une expérience préalable en soutien de niveau 1.
  • Expérience démontrée dans la gestion de problèmes techniques escaladés au sein d’un environnement dynamique et axé sur le service à la clientèle.
  • Expérience en mentorat ou en accompagnement du personnel de soutien de niveau 1, un atout.
  • Doit maîtriser couramment le français et l’anglais

Compétences techniques requises

  • Solide compréhension des technologies VoIP et du protocole SIP.
  • Capacité à capturer, lire et analyser des traces SIP et des captures de paquets (PCAP) à l’aide d’outils tels que Wireshark, afin de diagnostiquer et résoudre les échecs d’établissement d’appels, les problèmes d’enregistrement et les problèmes de qualité.
  • Bonne compréhension des concepts de réseautique IP, notamment le routage, le NAT, les pare-feu et la QoS.
  • Capacité à diagnostiquer des problèmes complexes de performance VoIP, notamment la qualité des appels, la latence, la gigue (jitter), la perte de paquets, l’audio unidirectionnel et l’écho.
  • Compréhension du routage des appels et du dépannage des plans de numérotation, notamment le routage entrant et sortant, la configuration des trunks SIP et le routage de relève (failover).
  • Expérience en gestion d’appareils tels que les téléphones IP et les ATA, incluant le provisionnement, la configuration, les mises à jour de micrologiciels (firmware) ainsi que le dépannage des problèmes d’enregistrement ou de connectivité.
  • Capacité à identifier les problèmes liés aux opérateurs télécom ou au réseau et à les escalader aux équipes appropriées.
  • Expérience avec les systèmes de billetterie (ticketing) et les outils de dépannage à distance.
  • Capacité à maintenir une documentation précise et détaillée des cas de soutien complexes, des analyses de causes fondamentales et des solutions apportées.
  • Capacité à résoudre les demandes et incidents clients escaladés de façon rapide et professionnelle.

Compétences clés

  • Excellentes compétences en dépannage avancé, en analyse et en résolution de problèmes.
  • Forte orientation vers le service à la clientèle et engagement envers un niveau élevé de satisfaction client, incluant la capacité à désamorcer les situations avec des clients frustrés.
  • Capacité à travailler de façon autonome tout en collaborant efficacement avec les équipes de soutien de niveau 1, le NOC et les équipes d’ingénierie.
  • Souci du détail et excellentes compétences en documentation.
  • Capacité démontrée à prendre en charge de façon autonome des problèmes techniques complexes, depuis l’enquête initiale jusqu’à leur résolution complète, en coordonnant les interventions des équipes internes et des fournisseurs tiers, tout en maintenant une communication claire et proactive avec les clients.
  • Capacité à communiquer clairement des concepts techniques à des interlocuteurs techniques et non techniques.

Atouts

  • Connaissance des Session Border Controllers (SBC) et des softswitches.
  • Expérience avec les fournisseurs de trunks SIP et les interconnexions avec les opérateurs télécom., T
  • Connaissance de protocoles supplémentaires tels que RTP.38 et DTMF.
  • Expérience en scripting ou en automatisation pour l’analyse des journaux (logs).
  • Certifications pertinentes telles que CompTIA Network+ ou Wireshark CertifiedNetwork Analyst (WCNA).
  • Connaissance de systèmes de billetterie tels que Zendeskou Jira Service Management.

    Job Requirements

    Education & Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in technical support, network operations, or VoIP support, including prior Tier 1 support experience
  • Demonstrated experience handling escalated technical issues in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment
  • Experience mentoring or providing guidance to Tier 1 support staff preferred
  • Must be fluent in both English and French

  • Technical Skills (Required)

  • Strong understanding of VoIP technologies and the SIP protocol
  • Ability to capture, read, and analyze SIP traces and packet captures (pcaps) using tools such as Wireshark to diagnose and solve call setup failures, registration issues, and quality problems
  • Solid understanding of IP networking concepts, including routing, NAT, firewalls, and QoS
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex VoIP performance issues such as call quality, latency, jitter, packet loss, one-way audio, and echo
  • Understanding of call routing and dial plan troubleshooting, including inbound/outbound routing, trunk configuration, and failover routing
  • Experience with device management for IP phones and ATAs, including provisioning, configuration, firmware updates, and troubleshooting registration or connectivity issues
  • Ability to identify and escalate carrier- or network-level issues to appropriate teams
  • Experience using ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools
  • Maintain accurate, detailed documentation of complex support cases, root cause analysis, and resolutions
  • Resolve escalated customer requests and incidents in a timely and professional manner

  • Core Competencies

  • Advanced troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Strong customer service orientation with a commitment to high customer satisfaction, including de-escalation of frustrated customers
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with Tier 1 support, NOC, and engineering teams
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation skills
  • Demonstrated ability to independently own complex technical issues from initial investigation through final resolution, coordinating across internal teams and third-party vendors while maintaining clear, proactive communication with customers.Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with session border controllers (SBCs) and softswitches
  • Experience with SIP trunking providers and carrier interconnects
  • Familiarity with additional protocols such as RTP, T.38, and DTMF
  • Scripting or automation experience for log analysis
  • Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Network+ or Wireshark Certified Network Analyst (WCNA)
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems such as Zendesk or Jira Service Desk

raw.description:
Reason One is hiring a Senior Project Manager with digital agency experience to manage innovative projects for clients like Emory Healthcare, Children’s Nebraska, and Beacon Health.

Healthcare is complex, deeply human work, and we’re seeking an experienced and skilled Project Manager who understands the operational realities of health systems and the needs of patients and communities, and delivers real results for stakeholders. You’ll have an opportunity to join a growing B Corp on a mission to improve digital access and equity in healthcare.

Your role

As Senior Project Manager at Reason One, you’ll be managing dynamic projects and teams following an established process. You’ll put your expertise and problem solving skills to work every day, tackling a wide scope of responsibilities for medium and large scale clients. Good instinct for identifying risks is vital, and a curious, collaborative attitude is ideal.

As a Senior Project Manager you are expected to bring your ideas to the table and provide suggestions to continuously improve project management processes.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver projects on time and within budget constraints.
  • Scope and estimate budget and schedule for new work
  • Provide clear and timely status reports to both internal and external stakeholders
  • Project Team Leadership enabling multi-disciplinary project teams to deliver their best work
  • Monitor and manage scope creep through formal change order processes or strategic descoping to maintain project profitability and timeline commitments
  • Ensure the scope roadmap and strategy are being followed.
  • Sign-off of various deliverables (e.g.: roadmaps, designs, requirements, launch approvals) to ensure quality standards are being met.
  • Appropriate Resource Management in collaboration with fellow PMs, ADs, and the Director of Delivery.
  • Stakeholder Communication (clear scope and expectation management)
  • Risk Management (documentation and mitigation strategies). Identify and manage project issues and risks in a professional and efficient manner
  • Work closely with clients or Account Directors to ensure client satisfaction and identify opportunities for strategic growth of the account
  • Champion continuous improvement by documenting project learnings, evolving PM processes accordingly, and ensuring team-wide awareness and adoption
  • When managing an SLA without an Account Director the following responsibilities will fall on the Project Manager
    • Invoicing
    • Reporting Missing Revenue
  • Work closely with Product owners to ensure the scope roadmap adheres to the budget and schedule.
  • Foster an environment of transparency for the project team by ensuring all information is shared and accessible to all team members at any project stage
  • Ability to demonstrate Reason One’s core values day to day
  • Participation in our B Corp mandate to improve our social and environmental impact through initiatives such as volunteering

Our must haves

  • 5+ years of digital project management experience in a digital agency
  • Agile methodology experience and/or scrum training
  • Clear and assertive written and oral communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines effectively
  • Strong organization skills
  • Strong leadership and facilitation skills are essential
  • Ability to navigate and negotiate client asks, know when to advise and when to be flexible
  • In depth experience setting up, managing and reporting on budget status and profitability
  • Working knowledge of PM software for client communication, resource management and task management such as JIRA, Basecamp, and Forecast.app, or similar tools
  • Experience delivering projects on CMS platforms such as WordPress, Optimizely, Kentico, Kontent.ai, Contentful or similar
  • Experience managing large-scale digital, marketing, and website projects. Experience with composable stacks with headless platforms preferred
  • Able to understand technical jargon and communicate with both technical and non-technical team members
  • Project management certifications or completion of project management training
  • Strong desire to learn and facilitate knowledge sharing within the department and across the company
  • Experience working with health systems or healthcare organizations as a Project Manager preferred
  • Experience using AI tools in your workflow to accelerate project management activities

The practicals

  • Location: Fully remote, work-from-home.
  • Status: Must reside and be eligible to work in the US or Canada. No exceptions.
  • Core hours: 9 AM–5 PM EST
  • Start date: As soon as possible
  • Reporting: This role reports to the Director of Project Management
  • This vacancy is for a new position within the organization. We are expanding our Project Management team to serve our clients even better. The individual hired will contribute to both new client work and continuing client engagements.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Annual salary $95,000 - $125,000 USD
  • 401K - 3% of salary after 6 months of employment
  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Benefit & Vision
  • Accidental Death and Dismemberment Benefit, Basic Life Benefit
  • Long Term Disability and Short Term Disability Benefit
  • Employee assistance program
  • Parental leave program - Up to 12 weeks for birthing parent, and up to 6 weeks for non birthing or adoptive parent
  • Paid Vacation days—15 days per year
  • Paid Sick leave—6 days per year
  • Paid Volunteer days—2 days per year
  • $200 USD home office stipend per year
  • $50 USD per month internet stipend
  • Training allowance of $800 USD a year and professional development opportunities like conferences and continuing education
  • A laptop is provided

Equal Opportunity

Reason One is an equal opportunity employer. This means that we strive to make employment decisions at every point of the employment, from application to termination, based on merit. We want to have the most qualified person in every position. In addition, we believe an equitable, diverse and inclusive workplace is one where all workers, whatever their gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, age, sexual orientation or identity, education or disability, feel valued and respected.

Applicants with disabilities who are qualified and selected for an interview will be accommodated upon request. ​​If we can offer reasonable accommodations to you in the application or interview processes, or if you have feedback on how we could improve the equity or accessibility of our recruitment, you are welcome to contact us with the subject line “Accommodation Request - Senior Fullstack Developer application”. Please note that we are unable to respond to general status inquiries or other messages that are unrelated to accessing our hiring processes.

AI Disclosure

AI may be used during the candidate assessment process, after interviews have taken place. Specifically, it may assist in comparing scorecards completed by the interview panel to help identify candidates' strengths and areas for development. Any AI-generated insights are reviewed, validated, and consolidated by the hiring manager, and form only one input into the final hiring decision, which is made by humans.Salary: $95,000 - $125,000

The successful candidate must have a strong educational background in the design of electric transmission design projects for high-voltage (HV) and extra high-voltage (EHV) overhead and underground electric utility lines. He/she will apply NESC, ASCE and other applicable standards in the engineering and design of electric transmission projects, including new capacity projects as well as infrastructure replacement projects. Candidate will primarily function in a principal engineering role performing design reviews on a regular basis, developing junior staff members, and contributing to bids and proposal development. Site-visits to client substation facilities are expected to be part of the work, along with occasional travel for client meetings and industry related events. Experience in front-facing client operations such as lunch and learns, and kick-off meetings if preferred. Candidate must comply with quality control and safe work practices and maintain compliance with project scope, schedule, and budget expectations. This position will be a principal role in a growing design team comprised of engineers, designers, and drafting technicians.

Required Education & Experience:
• 12+ years of relevant experience in the design of electric utility transmission systems
• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Civil Engineering

• P.E. License

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Experience with the following:

  • PLS-CADD, POLE, and TOWER
  • SAG10
  • LPILE or FAD
  • Microsoft Office suite

• Willingness to travel, up to 10%

Desired Skills and Attributes:

• Master’s degree in Civil Engineering

• Project Management Professional certification
• Knowledge of NESC code requirements, construction cost estimating, specification, material procurement processes, project schedule creation, and construction work packages.

• Autodesk AutoCAD

• Bentley MicroStation

• Bentley ProjectWise
• ESRI ArcGIS Programs

• Microsoft SharePoint

raw.excerpt: The Group Product Manager is accountable for leading the Membr product management team across the United Kingdom, Australia, and New Zealand, while also remaining close to the most important product problems.
raw.description:
The Group Product Manager is accountable for leading the Membr product management team across the United Kingdom, Australia, and New Zealand, while also remaining close to the most important product problems. This role leads and develops Product Managers across a distributed portfolio, creating clarity, focus, and momentum behind a compelling product vision for gym software customers.

Working closely with the VP of Product & Engineering, the Group Product Manager translates strategic direction into clear priorities, operating rhythms, and measurable customer outcomes. The role balances people leadership with hands-on product leadership across enterprise customers, including Anytime Fitness and JD Gyms, and a strong SMB customer base across AU/NZ/UK.

This role is also a key driver of product team culture and AI Transformation. The Group Product Manager will help modernise product practices for an AI-enabled operating environment, strengthen decision-making, and build the confidence, energy, and accountability needed for the team to do its best work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop Product Managers across the UK, Australia, and New Zealand, fostering high performance, accountability, engagement, and professional growth.

  • Shape and communicate a focused Membr product vision that gives teams clear direction and helps them rally behind shared customer and commercial outcomes.

  • Partner with the VP of Product & Engineering to translate strategic direction into clear, actionable roadmaps and priorities, and personally lead the highest-impact initiatives where direct product leadership is required.

  • Drive discovery, prioritisation, roadmap definition, and delivery outcomes for complex product problems, balancing enterprise depth with SMB customer needs.

  • Partner directly with enterprise customers, commercial teams, and senior stakeholders to validate opportunities, shape investment decisions, and translate customer needs into product strategy.

  • Lead AI Transformation within the product function by modernising outdated processes, improving discovery and prioritisation practices, and helping teams use AI responsibly to lift productivity and insight quality.

  • Manage prioritisation, planning, risks, and dependencies across product areas, ensuring delivery is transparent, outcome-focused, and aligned to strategic priorities.

  • Strengthen collaboration between Product, Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Sales, and Commercial teams to ensure coordinated delivery and effective go-to-market execution.

  • Coach Product Managers in product craft, commercial judgement, stakeholder management, discovery, delivery discipline, and AI-enabled ways of working, while modelling strong hands-on product practice.

  • Contribute to talent planning and hiring to grow and scale the product management capability within the Fitness & Wellness vertical.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Achievement of goals across the Membr product lines.

  • Portfolio-level delivery against roadmap, investment priorities, and customer outcome goals.

  • Customer metrics across enterprise and SMB segments: adoption, satisfaction, retention, NPS, and product usage health.

  • Commercial contribution of product, including ARR, revenue growth, churn reduction, expansion, and customer value creation.

  • Operational maturity of the product function, including cadence, quality, metrics, decision velocity, and AI-enabled process improvement.

  • Team engagement, capability uplift, leadership succession, and evidence of improved clarity, confidence, and momentum.

Core Capabilities

  • Player-coach product leadership: balances people leadership with direct ownership of product strategy, discovery, prioritisation, roadmap definition, and delivery outcomes.

  • Execution excellence: creates clarity of priorities, accountability, and predictable delivery across multiple workstreams without losing connection to execution detail.

  • AI Transformation: understands how AI can modernise product practices, improve team workflows, accelerate insight generation, and support better decision-making.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: drives strong alignment between Product, Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Sales, and Commercial teams.

  • Stakeholder management: communicates clearly and credibly with senior leaders, enterprise customers, commercial partners, and cross-functional peers.

  • Commercial awareness: understands customer needs, market dynamics, and how product delivery supports revenue, retention, expansion, and customer value.

  • Technical fluency: works effectively with engineering teams and understands product architecture fundamentals, platform trade-offs, and delivery constraints.

  • Adaptability: leads through change, managing competing priorities and ambiguity with composure, focus, and a bias toward practical progress.

  • 5+ years of experience in product management or related leadership roles within technology or SaaS companies.

  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing Product Managers or product teams, while also directly owning complex product strategy, discovery, prioritisation, and roadmap work.

  • Proven ability to deliver complex product roadmaps in collaboration with engineering, design, customer success, sales, and commercial stakeholders.

  • Strong grounding in product discovery, delivery practices, prioritisation, outcome measurement, and operational excellence.

  • Experience applying AI tools or AI-enabled practices to improve product management workflows, discovery, analysis, delivery, or decision-making.

  • Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and agile delivery methodologies.

  • Experience working in B2B SaaS environments; exposure to fitness, wellness, payments, franchise, or multi-location customer models preferred.

  • Strong leadership, coaching, stakeholder engagement, and change leadership skills.

  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in business, technology, or a related discipline preferred.

  • Experience leading through organisational change or scale-up environments advantageous.

Values and Life at Xplor

Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day:

  • Find a better way
  • Do the right thing
  • Say it straight
  • Win together
  • Own the outcome

If these values sound like you, and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor.

As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed.

Some of our perks and benefits are:

  • Paid Parental Leave benefit programs

raw.description:
Description

🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We're building a program for experienced engineers transitioning into system architecture roles. We need AI Systems Engineering practitioners who can do more than just know their craft — they need to help build the curriculum and turn their expertise into content others can learn from.

This is a content authoring role. You'll start by shaping the program syllabus based on our existing draft, then move into producing lessons using AI-gen tools — following our content guidelines, reviewing the output, and fine-tuning it until it's accurate and teachable. An LX designer will review your content and send comments back; you'll iterate from there. The best candidates are people who are opinionated about what good systems engineering looks like and what engineers need to learn, can spot when something is oversimplified or wrong, and are comfortable working in a structured production process and keeping up with deadlines.

Your audience: experienced engineers looking to level up to system architecture roles. They will spot shallow content instantly.

Format: async-first, project-based, estimated 4-6 months. We expect you to be ready to around 15-20 hrs/week.

Areas of expertise

We will bring on three SMEs, each focused on one of the following areas.

SME A — System Foundations, API & Data

  • Module 1 — Foundations of System Engineering (Architecture principles, OpenTelemetry, distributed systems)
  • Module 2 — API & Service Architecture (REST, GraphQL, gRPC, service boundaries, DDD)
  • Module 3 — Data Architecture & Storage Patterns (SQL/NoSQL, sharding, replication, Redis caching)

SME B — Cloud, Distributed Systems

  • Module 4 — Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering (Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps, CI/CD, FinOps)
  • Module 5 — Distributed Systems & Event-Driven Architecture (CAP theorem, event-driven, Kafka, alert routing)

SME C — Security, AI Systems & Architecture Leadership

  • Module 6 — Security & Compliance Architecture (Zero-trust, threat modeling, compliance, secure CI/CD)
  • Module 7 — AI Systems Design & Integration (LLM integration, RAG, ML reliability, AI governance)
  • Module 8 — Architecture Documentation & Leadership (ADRs, C4 diagrams, technical communication)

Please indicate in your application which area fits you best. If you have overlapping skills, don’t hesitate to apply and indicate it in your application. Submit all resumes or CV's in English.

What you will do

  • Review and shape the existing syllabus draft — validate topic sequencing, flag gaps or unrealistic scope, and make sure the content reflects how these systems are actually built in production.
  • Define clear learning objectives per topic: what should a student be able to do after this lesson, not just know.
  • Produce lessons using AI-gen tools following our content guidelines — then review, fact-check, and fine-tune the output until it's technically sound.
  • Design hands-on projects and exercises that are realistic for a working engineer studying 20 hrs/week.
  • Write supporting content: project instructions, rubrics, and reviewer guides.
  • Respond to LX designer feedback and iterate on content — this is a back-and-forth process, not a one-time handoff.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of real-world experience as a Senior Systems Engineer
  • Has designed and shipped systems at scale in a real company — not just coursework or side projects
  • Can explain why a decision was made, not just how it was implemented
  • Strong technical communication skills — ability to explain complex topics clearly to learners
  • Comfortable using AI tools for content drafting and iteration
  • Strong English C1+ — content will be in English for a US-based audience
  • Attention to detail, proactivity and ability to meet deadlines independently

What we can offer you

  • Milestone-based payments tied to deliverables
  • Fully remote work with flexible hours
  • A digital office — we use modern tools (Notion, Miro, Slack, Figma) to keep collaboration smooth
  • Professional trust and autonomy — no micromanaging
  • The chance to see real impact: our metric is graduates landing jobs in tech
  • Join a diverse, international, and close-knit team excited to work with you

Description

Minute Media is a global technology and content company built for the future of sports consumption. Minute Media’s proprietary technology platform enables the creation, distribution, and monetization of digital content experiences, powering Minute Media’s portfolio of trusted content brands, including Sports Illustrated, The Players’ Tribune, and FanSided, as well as third-party publishers and advertisers. The technology platform also includes STN Video, an online video platform (OVP) that provides access to a robust sports highlights rights portfolio. Minute Media is building the future of how the world connects with sport, powered by innovation, shared globally, and trusted by millions of fans and the partners we serve. For more information, visit .

Overview

The Account Management team is seeking an experienced account manager focused on display solutions to drive revenue optimization and performance across Minute Media’s portfolio. This role will focus on both our key display publishers to optimize and maximize performance.

The ideal candidate is an analytical, results-oriented professional with experience in providing operational insights and actionable optimizations in the digital media landscape. This role will be responsible for managing accounts primarily in North America and will require the individual to have flexible working hours to accommodate the timezones where our publishers are located.

What You'll Do

  • Analyze revenue, supply, and demand patterns to provide data-driven yield-maximization recommendations.
  • Evaluate and optimize display config settings, including monetization across Minute Media’s publisher partners.
  • Identify and resolve issues affecting Display delivery, errors, and margin loss across the business.
  • Provide regular insights on publisher performance, pricing strategies, and ad setup efficiency.
  • Maintain relationships with publishers, address reporting, billing cycle ownership, ad setup requests, and provide best-practice recommendations.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in digital media, revenue operations, AdOps, or media analysis. Experience at a publisher, agency, brand, or tech platform preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a quantitative or analytical field.

An overview of this role

As the Director of Regional Sales, you will lead a high-performing, field-based sales organization focused on GitLab's rapidly growing Department of War (DoW) federal business. You'll be accountable for driving new and expansion revenue across the DoW, acting as a co-captain with senior leadership while managing, coaching, and growing a team of Account Executives. You'll spend meaningful time in the field with key accounts, own large deal strategy and C-level negotiations, and guide your team through complex federal procurement motions, including distributors, partners, contracting vehicles, and funding cycles. By partnering closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing, you'll align our go-to-market approach for regulated environments, ensure our FedRAMP-authorized offerings and roadmap reflect agency needs, and build durable, land-and-expand growth across large, federated public sector organizations.

What you'll do

  • Lead, recruit, hire, and coach a high-performing team of Account Executives covering Department of War (DoW) to achieve regional revenue and growth targets while fostering an accountable, inclusive, high-performance culture across an all-remote organization.

  • Drive strategy and execution for new business and expansion, generating, progressing, and converting pipeline across key DoW accounts to meet or exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets.

  • Lead and execute complex federal procurement motions, working with distributors and partners such as Carahsoft and systems integrators and navigating contracting vehicles, funding cycles, and agency-specific buying processes to secure new multi-year contracts and expansions.

  • Drive go-to-market strategy for regulated environments, shaping FedRAMP-authorized offerings and mission-critical DevSecOps use cases across accounts to increase platform adoption and usage in priority accounts.

  • Collaborate closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and our federal distributor and systems integrator ecosystem to align on account plans, translate field requirements into roadmap and campaigns, and deliver a cohesive customer experience that supports retention and expansion.

  • Drive land-and-expand motions within large, federated organizations , securing new workloads, cross-sells, and upsells that balance near-term revenue goals with long-term platform adoption and multi-year growth.

  • Engage directly in the field and travel as needed to support key customer meetings, large deal reviews, and team engagements, deepening executive relationships and accelerating deal cycles while operating effectively in GitLab's asynchronous environment.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and leading regional, field-based sales teams in open source software, DevOps, or related enterprise technology environments.

  • Background in process- and data-driven sales operations, including advanced use of Salesforce and other CRM and marketing automation tools to run trackable, repeatable sales motions.

  • Experience selling or leading teams in regulated or compliance-driven environments (for example FedRAMP, impact levels, or similar government software-as-a-service frameworks), or the ability to ramp quickly in highly regulated markets.

  • Demonstrated success selling and guiding teams to sell complex enterprise deals into large public sector accounts, including long-cycle opportunities with multiple stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with formal sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or similar frameworks, including pipeline generation, qualification, forecasting, and deal inspection.

  • Ability to coach, develop, and hire sales talent while fostering an accountable, collaborative, and inclusive team culture.

  • Skill in managing C-level and senior stakeholder relationships, including running executive-level meetings and negotiations within large, federated organizations.

  • Alignment with GitLab's values and leadership expectations, with openness to candidates from diverse backgrounds who bring transferable skills in enterprise technology sales and team leadership.

About the team

The Department of War (DoW) federal sales team is a field-based, all-remote organization responsible for driving adoption of GitLab's DevSecOps platform across DoW organizations, including regulated and classified environments. You'll lead a group of Account Executives who collaborate asynchronously across regions and work closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and our federal distributor and systems integrator ecosystem to deliver consistent, predictable growth. raw.description:
About Us

Temporal is an open source programming model that can simplify code, make applications more reliable, and help developers focus on the important things like delivering features faster. We are on a mission to be the reliable foundation of every developer’s toolbox, and are building the team that will make that happen.
Our values guide us —they are present in how we show up, make decisions, and work together to make an impact. We’re curious, driven, collaborative, genuine and humble.
Temporal is growing and we are looking for those who share our values, challenge 'standard' thinking, and want to influence our future. If you have a passion for improving the developer experience, building world-class open-source software and communities, and want to be a part of our amazing team, we'd love to hear from you!

Summary

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our high-impact team focused on product scalability, customer experience, and revenue growth. Our team owns business-critical services including customer onboarding and off-boarding, billing and metering, cloud marketplace integrations, customer-facing usage and cost reporting, and the account data integrations that keep revenue systems in sync across the business.

In this role, you'll lead technical direction and build systems that directly impact Temporal's revenue engine and customer journey. You'll partner closely with engineers, product managers, finance, revenue operations, support, and sales to design resilient architectures, drive cross-functional execution, and raise the reliability and scalability bar for our billing, metering, and customer lifecycle platforms. If you enjoy owning ambiguous, high-leverage problems and building durable systems that scale with the business, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the Design of Business-Critical Systems: Own end-to-end technical design and delivery for services that power customer acquisition, onboarding/offboarding, and revenue operations.
  • Drive Architectural Excellence: Define and evolve system architecture for high-throughput, fault-tolerant metering and billing pipelines; make principled tradeoffs across correctness, latency, cost, and operability.
  • Own Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with Finance, RevOps, and Sales to translate business needs into robust, scalable systems—anticipating edge cases, ensuring auditability, and aligning stakeholders on milestones and risks.
  • Own the Account Lifecycle End to End: Build the flows that carry an account from acquisition through activation, expansion, billing, and offboarding—self-service and operator-initiated onboarding, plan and SKU changes, suspension, dunning, and clean offboarding.
  • Keep Revenue Data Coherent Across the Business: Own the integrations and pipelines that reconcile control-plane state with CRM, support, analytics, and BI systems, so finance, support, and sales operate on the same numbers.
  • Build Customer-Facing Usage and Cost Transparency: Design the APIs and metrics surfaces customers use to understand their spend—usage APIs, cost reporting, and billable-action metrics—with the accuracy and latency guarantees that make them trustworthy.
  • Ensure Data Integrity, Reliability, and Compliance: Build and operate distributed data systems with strong correctness guarantees; implement monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and runbooks that keep revenue-impacting pipelines trustworthy.
  • Raise the Engineering Bar: Set quality standards through code reviews, design reviews, and operational readiness; introduce patterns and tooling that improve maintainability and incident response.
  • Mentor and Multiply Impact: Mentor engineers, unblock execution, and foster a culture of ownership, learning, and pragmatic excellence.
  • Improve Developer and Customer Experience: Identify opportunities to streamline customer flows via automation, better tooling, and targeted platform improvements that reduce friction and support load.

Technology Stack

  • Primary Language: Go
  • Data Storage: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redshift, S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage
  • Data Processing: Kinesis, Firehose
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes
  • Billing & Revenue: Metronome, Stripe
  • Go-to-Market Integrations: Salesforce, Segment, Pylon, Zapier, cloud marketplace APIs
  • Customer-Facing Standards: OpenMetrics, FOCUS
  • Core Framework: Temporal (of course 😉)

What You'll Bring

  • Significant experience designing and delivering production-grade backend systems (ideally in cloud environments) with meaningful ownership over architecture and operational outcomes.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one systems/backend language (Go preferred), with the ability to navigate large codebases and drive technical decisions.
  • Demonstrated experience building and operating distributed systems: concurrency, reliability, scaling, consistency, and failure handling.
  • Practical understanding of data pipelines and storage systems (e.g., Postgres, Redshift, Kafka/Kinesis, S3-like systems) and how to ensure correctness and traceability.
  • Experience integrating and reconciling against third-party SaaS platforms (billing, CRM, support, analytics), including idempotency, drift detection, and recovery when an upstream system disagrees with your source of truth.
  • Experience with production operations: observability, incident response, performance tuning, on-call readiness, and continuous delivery.
  • Ability to work effectively across functions (Finance/RevOps/Sales/Support), translating ambiguous requirements into clear, executable technical plans.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write design docs, align stakeholders, and explain tradeoffs.
  • A "builder" mindset: you enjoy simplifying complex workflows, improving tooling, and leaving systems better than you found them.

What You Can Expect

  • High-impact ownership over systems tied directly to revenue, customer lifecycle, and platform scalability
  • Collaborative engineering culture focused on quality, pragmatism, and measurable outcomes
  • Exceptional technical colleagues and a feedback-rich environment
  • Lean processes and autonomy without unnecessary bureaucracy
  • Strong emphasis on reliability and operational excellence—balanced with rapid iteration
  • A team that values mentorship, thoughtful design, and steady improvements that compound over time

Compensation

  • The estimated pay range for this role is $176,000 - $231,000.
  • This role is also eligible to participate in Temporal’s equity plan.
Compensation ranges reflect salary and commission compensation (when applicable) across several geographic markets. Employment offers carefully consider multiple factors, including prior experience, knowledge, expertise, skillset, market location, and job level assessed during the interview process.
Employee benefits and perks below are for full-time employees, part-time or temporary positions are excluded.

U.S. Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO, 12 Holidays + 2 Floating Holidays
  • 100% Premiums Coverage for Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • AD&D, LT & ST Disability, and Life Insurance (Standard & Supplemental Available)
  • Empower 401K Plan
  • Additional Perks for Learning & Development, Lifestyle Spending, Home Office Setup, Professional Memberships, WFH Meals, Internet Stipend and more!

International Benefits

Paid Time Off (PTO) and Benefits outside the United States vary by country, and are issued in partnership with . Additionally, Temporal offers perks to all international employees for learning & career development, a lifestyle spending account, home office setup, professional memberships, work-from-home meals, and access to the Calm app for mental wellness.

Travel

Temporal is a globally distributed, collaborative team that values opportunities for in-person connection. Occasional travel may be required for company events, team offsites, and other meaningful moments that bring us together.

Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. The Senior Business Analyst (Sr. BA) serves as the primary liaison between Business, Product, and Data Engineering teams to successfully deliver data and analytics initiatives that support pharmaceutical commercialization.

The Sr. BA is responsible for gathering and documenting business requirements, managing end-to-end project delivery, facilitating Agile ceremonies, coordinating cross-functional teams, and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality data engineering solutions. This role works closely with business stakeholders, Product Managers, Data Engineers, QA, Architects, and leadership to drive projects from concept through production deployment while maintaining project governance and stakeholder alignment.

The ideal candidate possesses strong business analysis, project management, stakeholder communication, and Agile delivery skills, along with an understanding of modern data engineering concepts including ETL/ELT, cloud data platforms, data warehousing, reporting solutions, and data integration.

We're looking for people to record point-of-view videos of everyday household activities. You mount your smartphone on your head, go about your routine, and the camera captures exactly what you see. These videos help train AI systems and robots to understand how people interact with objects in real-world environments.

Do you wash dishes every day? Vacuum the rug? Walk the dog? Fold laundry? What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities

  • Record everyday household activities from a first-person perspective — cooking, cleaning, tidying up, folding laundry, gardening, walking the dog, and more

  • Follow short recording guidelines per session

• Earn while you do your household chores: up to $6 per hour equivalent depending on the project

An overview of this role

As the Director of Regional Sales, you will lead a high-performing, field-based sales organization focused on GitLab's rapidly growing Department of War (DoW) federal business. You'll be accountable for driving new and expansion revenue across the DoW, acting as a co-captain with senior leadership while managing, coaching, and growing a team of Account Executives. You'll spend meaningful time in the field with key accounts, own large deal strategy and C-level negotiations, and guide your team through complex federal procurement motions, including distributors, partners, contracting vehicles, and funding cycles. raw.excerpt: About UsTemporal is an open source programming model that can simplify code, make applications more reliable, and help developers focus on the important things like delivering features faster.
raw.description:
About Us

Temporal is an open source programming model that can simplify code, make applications more reliable, and help developers focus on the important things like delivering features faster. We are on a mission to be the reliable foundation of every developer’s toolbox, and are building the team that will make that happen.
Our values guide us —they are present in how we show up, make decisions, and work together to make an impact. We’re curious, driven, collaborative, genuine and humble.
Temporal is growing and we are looking for those who share our values, challenge 'standard' thinking, and want to influence our future. If you have a passion for improving the developer experience, building world-class open-source software and communities, and want to be a part of our amazing team, we'd love to hear from you!

Summary

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our high-impact team focused on product scalability, customer experience, and revenue growth. Our team owns business-critical services including customer onboarding and off-boarding, billing and metering, cloud marketplace integrations, customer-facing usage and cost reporting, and the account data integrations that keep revenue systems in sync across the business.

In this role, you'll lead technical direction and build systems that directly impact Temporal's revenue engine and customer journey. You'll partner closely with engineers, product managers, finance, revenue operations, support, and sales to design resilient architectures, drive cross-functional execution, and raise the reliability and scalability bar for our billing, metering, and customer lifecycle platforms. If you enjoy owning ambiguous, high-leverage problems and building durable systems that scale with the business, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the Design of Business-Critical Systems: Own end-to-end technical design and delivery for services that power customer acquisition, onboarding/offboarding, and revenue operations.
  • Drive Architectural Excellence: Define and evolve system architecture for high-throughput, fault-tolerant metering and billing pipelines; make principled tradeoffs across correctness, latency, cost, and operability.
  • Own Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with Finance, RevOps, and Sales to translate business needs into robust, scalable systems—anticipating edge cases, ensuring auditability, and aligning stakeholders on milestones and risks.
  • Own the Account Lifecycle End to End: Build the flows that carry an account from acquisition through activation, expansion, billing, and offboarding—self-service and operator-initiated onboarding, plan and SKU changes, suspension, dunning, and clean offboarding.
  • Keep Revenue Data Coherent Across the Business: Own the integrations and pipelines that reconcile control-plane state with CRM, support, analytics, and BI systems, so finance, support, and sales operate on the same numbers.
  • Build Customer-Facing Usage and Cost Transparency: Design the APIs and metrics surfaces customers use to understand their spend—usage APIs, cost reporting, and billable-action metrics—with the accuracy and latency guarantees that make them trustworthy.
  • Ensure Data Integrity, Reliability, and Compliance: Build and operate distributed data systems with strong correctness guarantees; implement monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and runbooks that keep revenue-impacting pipelines trustworthy.
  • Raise the Engineering Bar: Set quality standards through code reviews, design reviews, and operational readiness; introduce patterns and tooling that improve maintainability and incident response.
  • Mentor and Multiply Impact: Mentor engineers, unblock execution, and foster a culture of ownership, learning, and pragmatic excellence.
  • Improve Developer and Customer Experience: Identify opportunities to streamline customer flows via automation, better tooling, and targeted platform improvements that reduce friction and support load.

Technology Stack

  • Primary Language: Go
  • Data Storage: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redshift, S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage
  • Data Processing: Kinesis, Firehose
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes
  • Billing & Revenue: Metronome, Stripe
  • Go-to-Market Integrations: Salesforce, Segment, Pylon, Zapier, cloud marketplace APIs
  • Customer-Facing Standards: OpenMetrics, FOCUS
  • Core Framework: Temporal (of course 😉)

What You'll Bring

  • Significant experience designing and delivering production-grade backend systems (ideally in cloud environments) with meaningful ownership over architecture and operational outcomes.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one systems/backend language (Go preferred), with the ability to navigate large codebases and drive technical decisions.
  • Demonstrated experience building and operating distributed systems: concurrency, reliability, scaling, consistency, and failure handling.
  • Practical understanding of data pipelines and storage systems (e.g., Postgres, Redshift, Kafka/Kinesis, S3-like systems) and how to ensure correctness and traceability.
  • Experience integrating and reconciling against third-party SaaS platforms (billing, CRM, support, analytics), including idempotency, drift detection, and recovery when an upstream system disagrees with your source of truth.
  • Experience with production operations: observability, incident response, performance tuning, on-call readiness, and continuous delivery.
  • Ability to work effectively across functions (Finance/RevOps/Sales/Support), translating ambiguous requirements into clear, executable technical plans.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write design docs, align stakeholders, and explain tradeoffs.
  • A "builder" mindset: you enjoy simplifying complex workflows, improving tooling, and leaving systems better than you found them.

What You Can Expect

  • High-impact ownership over systems tied directly to revenue, customer lifecycle, and platform scalability
  • Collaborative engineering culture focused on quality, pragmatism, and measurable outcomes
  • Exceptional technical colleagues and a feedback-rich environment
  • Lean processes and autonomy without unnecessary bureaucracy
  • Strong emphasis on reliability and operational excellence—balanced with rapid iteration
  • A team that values mentorship, thoughtful design, and steady improvements that compound over time

Compensation

  • The estimated pay range for this role is $176,000 - $231,000.
  • This role is also eligible to participate in Temporal’s equity plan.
Compensation ranges reflect salary and commission compensation (when applicable) across several geographic markets. Employment offers carefully consider multiple factors, including prior experience, knowledge, expertise, skillset, market location, and job level assessed during the interview process.
Employee benefits and perks below are for full-time employees, part-time or temporary positions are excluded.

U.S. Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO, 12 Holidays + 2 Floating Holidays
  • 100% Premiums Coverage for Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • AD&D, LT & ST Disability, and Life Insurance (Standard & Supplemental Available)
  • Empower 401K Plan
  • Additional Perks for Learning & Development, Lifestyle Spending, Home Office Setup, Professional Memberships, WFH Meals, Internet Stipend and more!

International Benefits

Paid Time Off (PTO) and Benefits outside the United States vary by country, and are issued in partnership with . Additionally, Temporal offers perks to all international employees for learning & career development, a lifestyle spending account, home office setup, professional memberships, work-from-home meals, and access to the Calm app for mental wellness.

Travel

Temporal is a globally distributed, collaborative team that values opportunities for in-person connection. Occasional travel may be required for company events, team offsites, and other meaningful moments that bring us together.

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.
Temporal is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist.
We are not working with external recruitment agencies, thanks.

raw.description:
THE POSITION:

The Senior Business Analyst (Sr. BA) serves as the primary liaison between Business, Product, and Data Engineering teams to successfully deliver data and analytics initiatives that support pharmaceutical commercialization.

The Sr. BA is responsible for gathering and documenting business requirements, managing end-to-end project delivery, facilitating Agile ceremonies, coordinating cross-functional teams, and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality data engineering solutions. This role works closely with business stakeholders, Product Managers, Data Engineers, QA, Architects, and leadership to drive projects from concept through production deployment while maintaining project governance and stakeholder alignment.

The ideal candidate possesses strong business analysis, project management, stakeholder communication, and Agile delivery skills, along with an understanding of modern data engineering concepts including ETL/ELT, cloud data platforms, data warehousing, reporting solutions, and data integration.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

  • Partner with business stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document business, functional, and technical requirements for data engineering initiatives.
  • Translate business requirements into Epics, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, process flows, and functional specifications using Agile best practices.
  • Lead end-to-end project delivery by managing project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Manage Agile delivery using JIRA, including backlog prioritization, sprint planning, story refinement, progress tracking, and Agile ceremonies.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between Business, Product, Engineering, QA, and Architecture teams, ensuring effective stakeholder communication and alignment.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineers and Architects to support data integration, ETL/ELT, cloud data platform, reporting, and analytics initiatives.
  • Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management, release planning, deployment readiness, and Hypercare support to ensure successful solution delivery.
  • Monitor project health through status reporting, dashboards, executive communications, and proactive risk and issue management.
  • Maintain comprehensive project documentation, requirements traceability, governance artifacts, and SDLC deliverables while promoting documentation standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize delivery processes, standardize methodologies, and enhance Agile and project governance practices.
  • Mentor team members, foster collaboration, and promote knowledge sharing while demonstrating a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned

About HealthSnap:

HealthSnap () empowers patients and their physicians to improve health outcomes using an innovative platform for modern, proactive patient care. We help healthcare organizations easily manage chronic conditions remotely, and deliver personalized patient experiences when it's needed most.

Be part of an organization built on teamwork, innovation, mutual respect, and equality for all. We believe in the power of prevention over treatment, after our co-founders experienced how modern healthcare failed their loved ones, they knew there had to be a better way. We believe that every patient deserves to receive the right care, at the right time, and in the right location - regardless of their condition or status.

We lead with empathy above all else, and place the patient at the center of everything we do. Working at HealthSnap means being part of a family and a team where if you win, we all win, no matter how big or small the accomplishment. We take ownership - and lead with empathy - and expect each employee to recognize that real patients rely on HealthSnap every day.

Position Overview:

We are hiring Bilingual LPNs in multiple states to support patients who are enrolled in chronic care management and/or remote patient monitoring programs. This is done in partnership with the patients’ care team which may include primary or specialty physician practices or healthcare systems. Successful candidates will bring experience in educating patients on chronic diseases such as hypertension and diabetes. This is a full-time position that operates Monday through Friday, 9:00 am to 5:30 p.m. Eastern Time, unless otherwise specified.

As a Care Navigator, you will be trained in HealthSnap’s remote patient monitoring platform and will be responsible for communicating with enrolled patients in conjunction with the patients’ care team. Care Navigators typically have an assigned group of patients for which the Care Navigator is responsible for assisting throughout the month. Care Navigators also assist with other patients or patient tasks as assigned.

Above all else, you will play an essential role in establishing a relationship with assigned patients that allows you to empower them to manage their chronic illnesses and improve their health.

**Compact Nursing License required unless otherwise specified**

Key Responsibilities:

  • Patient Support: Complete phone consultations with patients enrolled in care management and/or remote patient monitoring programs, providing support and education about their chronic conditions.
  • Education and Empowerment: Educate patients about their health conditions and empower them with lifestyle and behavior strategies to actively manage their chronic conditions. Assist patients to set and reach goals in line with their provider-approved care plans.
  • Documentation: Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records, ensuring all interactions and care plans are documented per protocol.
  • Problem Solving: Address patient concerns and barriers to care, working to find practical solutions to improve patient adherence and outcomes.
  • Communication: Provide clear, compassionate, and effective communication to patients. Follow approved workflows regarding communicating patient needs to their providers.
  • Continuous Improvement: Participate in training sessions, team meetings, and quality improvement initiatives to enhance the care navigation process and patient experience.
  • Evaluation and Responding: Respond to remotely transmitted patient data such as blood pressure, blood glucose, weight, and pulse oximetry according to approved partner workflows.

Qualifications:

  • Education: A current, valid, and in good standing Multistate/Compact Nursing License (LPN/LVN)
    • Additional state licenses may be required and will be reimbursed by HealthSnap
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in primary care practice, cardiology, internal medicine, home care, or chronic care management/remote patient monitoring
  • Skills:
    • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
    • Ability to communicate, verbal and written, in Spanish.
    • Excellent organizational and time management abilities
    • Proficiency in using electronic health records (EHR) and care management software
    • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
    • Empathy and a patient-centered approach to care
  • Technical Requirements: Reliable internet connection and HIPAA-compliant work area and proficiency with virtual communication tools (e.g., Zoom, Slack)

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Opportunity for professional growth and development
  • Collaborative and inclusive work environment
  • Meaningful work that makes a positive impact on healthcare accessibility and outcome

Compensation:

Compensation is based on candidate's experience and the region in which the candidate lives.

We embrace diversity and are an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. No matter your background, your orientation, or your identity expression, if you are passionate about improving the future of healthcare through lifestyle change, we want to hear from you!

This is a highly technical, hands-on automation role focused on validating APIs, data and telemetry pipelines, distributed tracing, alerting, audit capabilities, infrastructure deployments, performance, and scalability. This is not a traditional UI-focused QA automation position.

You will develop automated regression suites, validate Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments, execute load and failure scenarios, investigate defects, and provide regression evidence throughout a sprint-based development lifecycle.

The ideal candidate combines strong test automation and scripting skills with enough knowledge of AWS, Terraform, OpenTelemetry, and distributed systems to effectively validate complex infrastructure and observability capabilities.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, maintain, and execute automated regression test suites.
  • Develop automated tests for log and metric ingestion pipelines.
  • Validate search and query functionality, accuracy, and latency.
  • Test distributed tracing accuracy and end-to-end telemetry flows.
  • Validate alert delivery, firing conditions, and routing behavior.
  • Develop automated tests for audit trail queries, integrity, and expected system behavior.
  • Validate Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments, including clean-state deployments, reproducibility, and zero-manual-step expectations.
  • Execute and help design load and scalability testing against defined performance targets.
  • Execute failure-injection scenarios and validate expected platform behavior.
  • Run regression testing across multiple versions and environments in parallel.
  • Identify, document, triage, and track defects against formal acceptance criteria.
  • Verify fixes and execute appropriate regression testing before quality sign-off.
  • Collaborate with the Test Architect and engineering teams to continuously improve regression coverage.
  • Maintain clear and reproducible automation code and testing documentation.
  • Provide regression evidence during sprint reviews and contribute to quality status reporting.
  • Work within Agile sprint cycles using formal acceptance criteria and Definition of Done (DoD).

Requirements:

  • 4+ years of professional experience as an SDET, Test Automation Engineer, QA Automation Engineer, or similar technical testing role.
  • Strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Strong API testing and automation experience.
  • Experience with scripting for technical validation and automation.
  • Experience with load and/or performance testing.
  • Working knowledge of cloud-based environments.
  • Experience testing complex backend, infrastructure, data pipeline, or distributed systems.
  • Experience working with formal acceptance criteria and Agile development processes.

Must Have:

  • 4+ years of professional SDET or test automation experience.
  • Strong hands-on test automation skills.
  • Strong API testing and API automation experience.
  • Experience developing automated regression suites.
  • Strong scripting skills for automation, pipeline validation, or log/data validation.
  • Experience with load and performance testing tools.
  • Experience testing backend, infrastructure-heavy, data-intensive, or distributed systems.
  • Working knowledge of AWS environments.
  • Working knowledge of Terraform-deployed environments and Infrastructure as Code concepts.
  • Working knowledge of OpenTelemetry-based systems.
  • Understanding of logs, metrics, telemetry, and distributed tracing concepts.
  • Experience validating data or telemetry pipelines.
  • Experience testing across multiple environments and/or product versions.
  • Experience with defect identification, triage, tracking, and fix verification.
  • Experience working with Jira or similar issue-tracking tools.
  • Experience working with formal acceptance criteria and Definition of Done (DoD).

Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience testing observability platforms.
  • Experience validating OpenTelemetry implementations.
  • Experience with log and metric ingestion testing.
  • Experience validating distributed tracing.
  • Experience testing alerting and notification workflows.
  • Experience validating audit trail integrity.
  • Experience with failure-injection or resilience testing.
  • Experience with high-volume data pipeline testing.
  • Experience with security-related regression testing.
  • Experience validating Infrastructure as Code deployments.
  • Experience testing ERP or complex enterprise platforms.
  • Experience working across multiple versions of the same enterprise application.
  • Experience with CI/CD-integrated automated regression suites.

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to work on technically challenging quality engineering problems that go well beyond traditional UI automation.

You'll build automated regression coverage for distributed and infrastructure-heavy systems involving telemetry, APIs, data pipelines, cloud environments, performance, and Infrastructure as Code. You'll collaborate closely with engineering and quality architecture teams while helping ensure that complex platform capabilities remain reliable as they evolve across continuous sprint deliveries.
