  • Employee benefits
  • Guaranteed training or coaching hours
  • A traditional in-house role

Please do not apply.

This opportunity is for experienced learning, development, training and coaching professionals who enjoy working with different organisations and can confidently represent Rosie's People within client environments.

About Rosie's People

Rosie's People is an award-winning International HR/People & Business Operations consultancy supporting founders, leadership teams and growing organisations across the UK and internationally.

We provide strategic People advisory, organisational consulting, operational HR & business support, leadership and management development, coaching, talent solutions and executive recruitment.

As our client portfolio continues to grow, we are expanding our network of experienced independent L&D consultants, trainers, facilitators and professional coaches who can support client projects as requirements arise.

HOW TO APPLY

Please submit your CV/resume together with a cover letter explaining why you believe you would be a strong addition to the Rosie's People consultant network.

Within your cover letter, please answer the following six mandatory questions.

Applications that do not answer all six questions will not be considered.

1. Location, Right to Work & Delivery Availability
Where are you currently based, where do you have the right to work, and which locations could you reasonably support in person? Please also confirm whether you deliver in person, virtually or both.

2. Recent Training, L&D or Coaching Experience
Please describe up to three relevant projects or assignments you have worked on within the last three years. For each, briefly explain the client or organisation type, what you were engaged to do, your personal role in the project, the audience you supported and the outcome.

3. Programme Design & Delivery
Please give one example of a training, learning or development programme that you personally designed, co-designed and/or delivered from beginning to end. What did you personally create or deliver, how was the programme structured, and how did you or the client assess whether it had been successful?

4. Qualifications, Coaching & Industry Experience
Please list your relevant training, L&D, facilitation, organisational development and/or coaching qualifications and professional accreditations. If you provide professional coaching, please include your coaching qualification/accreditation and professional body. Please also list the industries or sectors in which you have delivered training, development or coaching professionally.

5. Consultancy Availability & Rates
What project capacity could you typically make available to Rosie's People, and how quickly could you mobilise for a new assignment? Please provide your expected hourly, half-day and full-day consultancy rates, excluding applicable taxes, and confirm whether reasonable preparation and customisation are included within those rates.

Applications stating market rate, negotiable, dependent on scope, what's the budget? or similar responses will not be considered.

6. AI, Learning Technology & Systems
Please list the AI tools, learning platforms, collaboration tools and productivity software you use professionally. Next to each, rate your competency as:

Beginner | Intermediate | Expert | Never Used

About the Opportunity

Successful applicants may be added to Rosie's People's approved consultant network and considered for client assignments as requirements arise.

Depending on the assignment, you may be asked to design, develop, facilitate and/or deliver learning and development interventions, provide individual or group coaching, support wider organisational-development projects, or contribute specialist expertise as part of a broader Rosie's People client engagement.

Some assignments may involve delivering an established programme or framework. Others may require you to work with the client and us to understand a particular organisational need and develop an appropriate intervention.

You may work independently on some assignments and alongside other Rosie's People consultants on others. In either case, we expect consultants to work within the agreed client scope, maintain appropriate communication, protect confidentiality and escalate issues appropriately.

Our Ideal Consultant

We're particularly interested in people who:

  • Have at least five years' relevant professional experience in L&D, training, facilitation, organisational development and/or professional coaching.
  • Have demonstrable experience working with managers, leaders and/or professional populations.
  • Can evidence personally designing, developing and delivering high-quality learning or development interventions.
  • Can adapt their approach to different organisations, industries, audiences and organisational cultures.
  • Are confident facilitating interactive sessions and responding appropriately to questions, challenge and discussion.
  • Can translate organisational needs into practical learning or development interventions.
  • Are comfortable working both independently and as part of a wider consultancy delivery team.
  • Communicate credibly and professionally with senior stakeholders.
  • Understand confidentiality and professional boundaries.
  • Are commercially aware, organised and reliable.
  • Can confidently represent the Rosie's People brand within client organisations.

Relevant L&D, training, facilitation, CIPD, CMI, ILM, ICF, EMCC or equivalent professional qualifications/accreditations are highly desirable.

Important

Joining the Rosie's People consultant network does not constitute an offer or guarantee of work, minimum hours or a particular client assignment.

Consultants are considered for assignments according to the client's requirements, relevant expertise and industry experience, location, availability, delivery style, client/cultural fit and agreed commercial terms.

Where selected for a specific assignment, the scope, deliverables, rates, preparation requirements, travel expectations, duration and other relevant terms will be agreed before any work commences.

Rosie's People is a remote-first, inclusive and equal opportunities consultancy. If you require reasonable adjustments during our selection process, please include a Reasonable Adjustment Request section within your cover letter.

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $90/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

raw.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $90/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Become a part of our caring community

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to design and deliver Generative AI applications as part of the Growth Analytics & AI team. You will focus on building innovative, scalable, and reliable LLM‑based solutions that produce insights from conversational and long‑form unstructured data to inform business strategy, increase operational efficiency, and improve customer experience.
The ideal candidate combines strong applied GenAI and machine learning expertise with solid software engineering practices, demonstrates curiosity in exploring new approaches and use cases, and communicates effectively with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders. This role partners with product, engineering, and platform teams to translate complex business problems into production‑ready AI solutions and move high‑value use cases from concept to impact..

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and deploy LLM-based applications for conversational intelligence and insight generation.
  • Develop multi-step AI workflows, including retrieval, orchestration, routing, and tool-using patterns.
  • Define and implement evaluation approaches for LLM applications, including response quality, reliability, safety, and value.
  • Work with large-scale structured and unstructured data using modern data platforms (e.g., Spark, Databricks, Snowflake).
  • Partner with engineering teams to move GenAI solutions from prototype to production.
  • Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to shared development practices such as version control, documentation, and code review.
  • Ensure solutions align with enterprise standards for security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of experience, Master's degree and 3+ years, or PhD candidate in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and modern development practices for AI applications.
  • Expertise in working with natural language data and building text-based products, using both classic and state-of-the-art NLP techniques (e.g. text mining, word embeddings, transformer-based models)
  • Experience with LLM prompt engineering and architectural patterns for LLM systems (e.g., retrieval‑augmented generation, multi‑agent designs).
  • Hands‑on experience building tool‑integrated and agent‑based LLM workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar.
  • Experience working with cloud and data platforms such as Azure, Databricks, GCP, and Snowflake.
  • Experience designing, evaluating, and supporting AI applications in production or enterprise environments.
  • Experience with data governance, privacy, security, and compliance requirements.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with technical and non-technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related quantitative field.
  • Experience in the healthcare, medical, or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Hands-on experience in MLOps, DevOps, or software engineering.
  • Demonstrated depth in machine learning and generative AI, with a strong applied understanding of LLM behavior, evaluation, reliability, and trade‑offs.
  • Proven hands‑on experience building end‑to‑end GenAI and agentic AI solutions.
  • Experience building GenAI solutions that operate on long‑context data such as chats, transcripts, and long‑form documents in real‑world, production scenarios.

Additional Information

The candidate must be able to work within the Eastern or Central Standard Time zones.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$117,600 - $161,700 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.Application Deadline: 08-25-2026


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

Janea Systems (USA) is a dynamic team of the best & brightest software engineering specialists and solutions innovators, from around the world. From kernel to cloud, we provide high-impact software development services to Fortune 500 companies.

We are seeking an exceptionally talented Account Manager to join our rapidly growing consulting team.

Memurai, a product built and maintained by Janea Systems, brings Redis capabilities natively to Windows enterprise environments. As an official Redis partner, Memurai is trusted by a growing number of enterprises running mission-critical workloads and AI on Windows infrastructure. It gives development and operations teams a native, fully supported alternative to running Redis on Linux.
With the release of Memurai for Redis 8, Windows enterprise teams can now build AI-powered applications natively — including vector search, semantic caching, and RAG pipelines — without leaving their existing infrastructure. There has never been a better time to join.

We are seeking a commercially minded operator to own the full customer revenue lifecycle at Memurai — from closing new business to managing renewals, identifying growth opportunities, and building lasting relationships with technical buyers. This is a hands-on, full-cycle role for someone equally comfortable closing deals and managing accounts. You will own customer revenue end-to-end in a lean, fast-moving SaaS environment where initiative matters more than process.

This is not a role for an enterprise deal hunter who needs a large support team, nor for a pure customer success function focused on onboarding frameworks. It is for someone who wants real commercial ownership, direct line of sight to customer outcomes, and the opportunity to help shape Memurai’s growth.

Location

Fully Remote/ European Residence Required

Compensation

Base salary + variable plan

Work Schedule

Fully Flexible

Reports to

Head of GTM

Member of

Memurai Team

To be considered for this position, you must have the following qualifications:

  • 3+ Years of B2B SaaS Commercial Experience: A proven track record managing the full commercial customer lifecycle — from new business to renewals and expansion — in a SaaS environment, preferably selling to technical buyers such as developers, DevOps teams, or IT infrastructure teams.
  • Full-Cycle Commercial Ownership: Demonstrated ability to independently close inbound and self-sourced opportunities, manage an active book of accounts, and drive renewals without heavy process infrastructure behind you.
  • Technical Credibility: Comfortable engaging with infrastructure and engineering audiences at a technical level. Experience with data infrastructure, caching, or developer tooling — at companies such as Redis, JetBrains, MongoDB, Percona, Couchbase, or similar — is a strong plus.
  • CRM Proficiency: Comfortable working with Pipedrive, Zoho, or comparable CRM and sales tooling to maintain accurate pipeline data, activity records, and account hygiene.
  • Excellent Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication, with the confidence to run discovery, qualification, and deal navigation independently and without escalation as the default.
  • Startup Mindset: Comfortable in lean, fast-paced environments where not every process is defined, and where your ability to figure things out matters as much as your experience.

Ideal candidates will also have:

  • Partnership and Channel Experience: A proactive approach to following up on and developing opportunities with channel partners, resellers, and technology ecosystem partners, including those in the Microsoft partner network.
  • Expansion and Upsell Track Record: Experience identifying and closing expansion revenue opportunities within an existing customer base, including proactive account reviews and structured upsell conversations.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the full commercial customer lifecycle for Memurai — new business, renewals, and account growth
  • Manage and close inbound opportunities efficiently and independently, from first contact through signed agreement
  • Proactively identify and reach out to likely-fit prospects when inbound volume requires supplementing
  • Manage a book of existing customer accounts, conducting regular check-ins, driving renewals, and identifying upsell and expansion opportunities
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships with technical buyers across developer, DevOps, and IT infrastructure teams
  • Coordinate with product, support, and engineering teams when customer needs require it, serving as the customer’s internal advocate
  • Maintain accurate pipeline and account data in the CRM to improve forecast visibility and deal hygiene
  • Follow up on leads from channel partners, resellers, and technology ecosystem partners
  • Contribute field feedback to marketing and product on messaging gaps, objections, and customer insights

What Success Looks Like:

  • 30 days: You understand the Memurai product, positioning, and existing customer base. You are running your own calls and have taken ownership of active deals and accounts.
  • 90 days: You have closed new business, handled your first renewals cleanly, and have a clear picture of expansion opportunities in the existing book.
  • 6 months: You are consistently delivering on new business and renewal targets, and customers know you as their go-to commercial contact at Memurai.

Why join Janea? Because world-class talent deserves world-class opportunities. What we offer:

  • Competitive compensation with benefits, paid vacation, and sick leave.
  • The opportunity to work with a globally diverse team of top Marketing & Sales talent on the industry’s toughest Sales challenges.
  • Ultra-flexible working conditions – we provide a generous office equipment allowance so you can work from home, we can also provide you with a desk at an office/coworking facility near you, or use both. No business travel necessary.
  • An enjoyable, start-up work environment, with excellent opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • Flexible working hours – as a remote-first company, our focus has always been on getting the job done well, not when or where it gets done.

With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories!

Key Responsibilities:

The Senior Project Manager, Global Fulfilment leads the end-to-end delivery, governance, and strategic programme management of World Vision's Global Fulfillment portfolio of sponsor engagement products. The role is responsible for translating business priorities into successful project delivery, leading the planning, coordination and execution of globally produced Sponsor Engagement products, including Annual Progress Reports, Christmas Cards, Child Expression Worksheets, Printed Letter Workflow and future Global Fulfilment initiatives. The role provides programme leadership across multiple global initiatives, ensuring effective project governance, procurement and vendor management, financial stewardship and cross-functional collaboration. The Senior Project Manager drives continuous improvement, manages strategic risks and dependencies, oversees commercial engagements, and provides executive-level reporting to ensure products are delivered on time, within budget and to global quality standards.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Programme & Project Delivery

Lead the end-to-end project management of global Sponsor Engagement products including Annual Progress Reports, Christmas Cards, Child Expression Worksheets and Printed Letter Workflow. Establish governance, maintain project plans, RAID logs, decision registers, documentation, reporting, business requirements, process maps and delivery schedules. Identify recurring operational issues and root causes. Facilitate workshops, coordinate cross-functional teams, and resolve delivery issues.

Commercial & Vendor Management

Lead the commercial and vendor management activities for the Global Fulfillment portfolio, including procurement planning, development of Statements of Work (SOWs), Requests for Proposal (RFPs), contract development and renewals, vendor evaluation, onboarding, performance management, SLA’s, governance and issue resolution. Partner with Procurement, Legal and Finance to ensure contracts, purchasing activities and supplier relationships comply with organisational policies and deliver value for money.

Financial Management

Develop and manage programme budgets including annual planning, forecasting, financial tracking, global chargebacks, invoice management and financial reporting. Ensure expenditure aligns with approved budgets and organisational policies.

Strategic Leadership and continuous improvement

Provide strategic project leadership by identifying operational efficiencies, improving governance processes, driving cross-team collaboration, supporting portfolio planning and preparing executive communications, dashboards, AI opportunities and steering committee updates. Coach project teams on project management best practiceS and continuous improvement.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Project Management, Information Systems, or related discipline.
  • Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, Agile Project Management or equivalent certification preferred.

  • Extensive experience managing multiple concurrent initiatives across international and cross-cultural teams.
  • Strong business analysis and requirements gathering experience.
  • Experience developing governance frameworks, reporting, and executive communications.
  • Extensive experience managing end-to-end procurement processes, including developing Statements of Work (SOWs), Requests for Proposal (RFPs), vendor evaluation and contract negotiations.
  • Demonstrated experience managing third-party vendors, supplier performance and commercial relationships.
  • Experience partnering with Procurement, Legal and Finance to establish and manage contracts and ensure compliance with organisational policies.
  • Experience managing significant project budgets and financial reporting.
  • Experience facilitating workshops, stakeholder engagement and executive decision-making.
  • Proven ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities and organisational change.
  • Excellent written and verbal English.
  • Occasional international travel (up to 10%) as required.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE AND OTHER QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience within international NGOs or global development organisations.
  • Knowledge of Sponsor Engagement, Sponsorship or Customer Experience operations.
  • Familiarity with digital and print product delivery and operational process improvement.
  • Experience working within matrix organisations.
  • Experience using Azure DevOps, Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project or similar project management platforms.

Local Applicants Only

World Vision is a Christian humanitarian organisation with a mission centred on following Jesus Christ in service to the world´s most vulnerable children. Therefore, in all locations to the fullest extent legally permissible, the successful applicant will affirm our core documents, observe conduct compatible with Christian principles, serve at a high level of professional ethics and strive to act in accordance with cultural sensitivities. About Allied Roofing Partners

Allied Roofing Partners (ARP) is a rapidly growing organization focused on partnering with strong roofing and exterior home improvement companies across the United States. Through strategic acquisitions, ARP provides its partner companies with the resources, technology, leadership, and operational support needed to accelerate growth while maintaining the strengths that made each business successful.

ARP continues to expand through approximately
5–8 acquisitions annually, creating outstanding opportunities for talented professionals who want to play an important role in building and scaling a growing organization.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Integrations Manager to help lead the successful integration of newly acquired companies into the ARP organization.

This is a highly visible, hands-on

project management and operational integration role. The Integrations Manager will serve as the central coordinator for acquisition integration activities, ensuring cross-functional teams remain aligned, key deliverables are completed on time, milestones are properly coordinated, and responsible parties remain accountable for their commitments.

The successful candidate will be highly organized, comfortable working across multiple business functions, and able to manage numerous moving pieces simultaneously. This individual will work closely with executive leadership, functional leaders, and leadership teams at newly acquired companies to move each acquisition from planning through successful operational integration.

While technology and systems are an important component of integration, this is not an IT-focused position. We are looking for a strong project and operations professional who is comfortable working with CRM, project management, financial, HR, and other business systems.

Key Responsibilities

Acquisition Integration & Project Management

  • Manage acquisition integration activities from pre-close planning through Day 1 readiness and post-close implementation.
  • Develop and maintain integration plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and ownership across multiple simultaneous acquisitions.
  • Coordinate integration meetings, track action items, follow up with responsible parties, and hold stakeholders accountable for deadlines and commitments.
  • Identify risks, delays, and dependencies early and escalate issues appropriately to leadership.
  • Provide clear, concise integration status updates to executive leadership.

Operational Integration & Coordination

  • Coordinate integration activities across Operations, Finance, HR, Payroll, Benefits, IT, Legal/Compliance, Marketing, and other functional areas.
  • Assist with the operational and logistical transition of newly acquired companies, helping ensure continuity and minimal disruption during integration.
  • Partner with acquired-company leaders to communicate integration requirements, timelines, processes, and expectations.
  • Help identify operational gaps and translate acquisition diligence findings into actionable integration plans.
  • Travel to newly acquired companies as needed to support integration activities and operational transitions.

Systems, Processes & Continuous Improvement

  • Support the transition and alignment of CRM, project management, financial/accounting, document management, and other business systems.
  • Coordinate with IT and functional system owners on system-related integration activities while maintaining focus on the overall business and operational integration.
  • Maintain and continuously improve ARP's integration playbook, checklists, templates, trackers, and processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve integration speed, consistency, communication, and accountability.

Compensation & Benefits

Allied Roofing Partners offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support our employees both professionally and personally.

  • $100,000–$125,000 Base Salary, based on experience
  • 10% Annual Bonus Opportunity
  • Full-Time W-2 Position
  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) / Vacation
  • Paid Holidays
  • Company-provided technology and resources needed to perform the role
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Long-term career advancement opportunities within a rapidly growing organization

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in project management, operations, business integration, program management, or a similar cross-functional role.
  • Experience supporting acquisitions, integrations, business transitions, implementations, or other complex organizational change is strongly preferred.
  • Recent experience within the roofing, construction, exterior home improvement, or skilled trades industry is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, stakeholders, deadlines, and competing priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong operational and business acumen with the ability to understand how different functional areas work together.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, Monday.com (highly desirable), project/task management tools, and other business systems.
  • Familiarity with HRIS/payroll, ERP/accounting, or document-management platforms is a plus.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Teams.
  • Exceptional organization, communication, follow-through, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to respectfully hold stakeholders accountable for commitments and deadlines, including individuals outside of the position's direct reporting authority.
  • Proactive problem solver who can anticipate roadblocks and drive issues toward resolution.
  • Comfortable communicating and working directly with C-suite executives, senior leaders, and acquired-company leadership.
  • Ability and willingness to travel occasionally to newly acquired companies as needed.

Why Join Allied Roofing Partners?

This is an opportunity to join a rapidly growing organization and have a direct impact on how newly acquired companies successfully become part of Allied Roofing Partners.

With approximately 5–8 acquisitions completed annually, this role will have significant exposure to executive leadership and the opportunity to help develop and improve the processes ARP uses to integrate and scale its growing portfolio of companies.

If you're a highly organized project and operations professional who enjoys bringing people together, creating structure, solving problems, and driving complex initiatives through completion, we'd love to hear from you.

Salary: $100,000–$125,000 Base Salary + 10% Annual Bonus

raw.description:
your mission

At AVIAN, our mission is clear: we stop fires before they start. Our infrared camera systems and AI-driven monitoring help industrial companies detect abnormal heat early, prevent fire risk, protect assets, and avoid costly downtime.

We have reached product-market fit. We have the product, the proof, and strong customer demand. Now we need the marketing engine.

As Marketing Lead, your mission is to build an AI-forward marketing function that helps AVIAN scale to $10M+ ARR. This is not a traditional marketing role. We are not trying to hire a large team or manage a network of agencies. We want one exceptional operator using AI agents, automation, and sharp positioning to do the work of a small team.

You will own the 1-to-many growth engine: brand authority, demand generation, content, website conversion, lifecycle marketing, event amplification, and AI-driven outbound support.

You will:

  • Build AVIAN’s AI-forward marketing operating model from the ground up.
  • Own LinkedIn, founder-brand content, and high-signal thought leadership for industrial fire prevention, insurance, and manufacturing.
  • Use AI workflows to create programmatic content at scale across customer stories, vertical pages, SEO/AIO pages, outbound assets, and sales enablement.
  • Build AI-driven outbound research and enrichment workflows for priority accounts, sectors, and buying committees.
  • Design lifecycle automation beyond standard nurture, including lead scoring, reactivation, segmentation, trigger-based campaigns, and sales handoff.
  • Improve AVIAN’s website conversion, landing pages, SEO, and AI-search visibility.
  • Turn trade fairs into pipeline through pre-event targeting, content, booking flows, on-site support, and post-event follow-up.
  • Build and manage lean growth experiments across paid, organic, email, content, and partner channels.
  • Work closely with sales to convert marketing activity into qualified pipeline and revenue.
  • Track what works, cut what does not, and build repeatable systems.
This is a hands-on IC role. You will write, build, automate, launch, analyze, and improve.

your profile

You are a mid-to-senior marketing operator who ships. You know how to build when there is no playbook, and you have already used AI to replace manual marketing work in production.

Must-haves:

  • Experience as a #1 or #2 marketing hire at a B2B startup, ideally in deep-tech, industrial SaaS, hardware-enabled SaaS, IoT, insurance-tech, or a related category.
  • Proven track record building pipeline in a startup or scale-up environment.
  • Evidence of agentic AI workflows in production, not just prompting or experimentation.
  • Ability to demo AI workflows you have shipped, such as outbound research agents, enrichment pipelines, programmatic content systems, lifecycle automation, custom GPTs, Claude projects, Clay workflows, Lindy agents, n8n automations, or similar.
  • Public evidence of an AI-native marketing point of view, such as writing, side projects, GitHub, Loom walkthroughs, shipped tools, or documented workflows.
  • Strong content ability across positioning, landing pages, LinkedIn, founder voice, email, and sales enablement.
  • Strong demand-generation instincts across inbound, outbound support, events, lifecycle, and conversion.
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot or similar CRM and marketing automation systems.
  • Ability to operate without a large team, agency layer, or perfect process.
  • Strong analytical discipline and clear ROI thinking.
  • High ownership, direct communication, and bias for action.
  • Fluent English.
Nice-to-haves:
  • Experience marketing to manufacturers, plant managers, safety teams, maintenance leaders, insurers, brokers, or industrial operators.
  • Experience in industrial IoT, fire prevention, predictive maintenance, machine vision, automation, safety tech, or hardware-enabled SaaS.
  • Experience with SEO, AIO, programmatic landing pages, paid search, paid social, and conversion optimization.
  • Experience planning and executing trade fair marketing.
  • German language skills.
  • Based in Zurich, Europe, or a major US industrial hub.

why us?

AVIAN is building a new category in industrial fire prevention. Our product protects real facilities, real assets, and real people. The impact is immediate, measurable, and operationally critical.

You will join at the right stage: product-market fit is proven, customer demand is real, and the commercial organization is ready to scale. This is the opportunity to build a modern marketing function from scratch, with AI at the center rather than bolted on afterward.

What we offer:

  • Direct reporting line to the CEO.
  • Full ownership of AVIAN’s marketing engine.
  • Opportunity to build an AI-forward function that replaces the work of a small team.
  • Clear mandate to create pipeline, brand authority, and repeatable growth systems.
  • Competitive compensation.
  • Performance-based variable compensation tied to pipeline and ARR milestones.
  • Equity participation.
  • Budget authority for tools, experiments, events, and selective external support.
  • Flexible, high-trust working model.
  • International team with a clear mission and strong customer focus.
  • Opportunity to help scale AVIAN to $10M+ ARR and beyond.
The AVIAN Way:
  • Clarity, ownership, speed. Everyone owns outcomes end-to-end.
  • Fail fast, fix faster. We learn quickly and improve continuously.
  • Radical transparency. Shared knowledge, open decisions, constant feedback.
  • Global and focused. International team, customer-obsessed, real-world impact.
AVIAN is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request.

raw.description:
About The Position

The KIPP Foundation is investing heavily in resources and strategies to increase the number of KIPP alum who graduate from college. To that end, we’re hiring several new Directors of College Partnerships to identify, cultivate, and formalize college/university partnerships that position KIPP alum to enroll and persist in colleges compatible for their aspirations and needs.

Our incoming Director of College Partnerships – West will oversee this work in our Western portfolio, which comprises KIPP regions in California and Colorado + college/universities in those areas and several surrounding states. We will consider you our primary point person and expert on college partnerships across the Western terrain.

In this role, you’ll: identify and cultivate university partnerships; negotiate and formalize MOUs that capture partnership agreements, and; collaborate with our national College Advancement and regional KIPP Forward teams to ensure partnerships are leveraged and aligned to students’ needs.

This is an excellent opportunity for a mission-aligned individual who enjoys building and leveraging relationships to achieve ambitious goals. Our ideal hire will have excellent communication and enjoy leveraging them to inform and invest others in our vision and efforts. You’re someone who is comfortable working autonomously while also being invested – and skilled - in collaboration that will maximize collective opportunities and performance. You have the organizational, project management, and portfolio management skills to structure fast-paced work across a broad geographic portfolio and matrixed organization. You are invested in data-informed decision making and have the skill required to track and analyze data, at the portfolio level, that helps you make strategic partnerships decisions.

You’ll report to our VP of College Partnerships and sit, alongside a suite of Directors of College Partnerships, on our broader College Advancement and Partnerships team.

Responsibilities

1. Build and Manage a Portfolio of Partnerships

a. Identify, cultivate, and formalize university partnerships that increase college enrollment and completion for KIPP students & alum. This will require a blend of: fortifying existing partnerships, reactivating dormant partnerships, and building entirely new partnerships with national universities, regional institutions, HBCUs, and HSIs.

b. Develop, negotiate, and finalize MOUs, stewarding the development of clear commitments and measurable, symbiotic goals that fuel our path to our 2030 vision

c. Ensure we, and partnerships, maintain our MOUs, fulfilling agreements as outlined and revising commitments as needed to align with evolving context, outcomes, and needs

2. Internal Collaboration and Regional Support

a. Partner with our national College Advancement Team and regional KIPP Forward teams to integrate partnerships into student advising and match strategies

b. Exchange work & best practices with other Directors of College Partnerships, fueling cohesion, ability to reach ambitious goals, and stronger collective performance

3. Knowledge Management

a. Strengthen our institutional memory of strategies, plans, wins, and challenges with college partners

b. Support the codification of our best practices

4. Strategic Planning

a. Contribute to the development of our College Partnerships strategy, including the determination of partnerships criteria, baseline MOU structure, goals, benchmarks, and accountability structures.

Skills and Mindsets

Core Mindsets:

  • Strong Alignment to our Mission and Student Focus: Demonstrates passion for, and commitment to, KIPP’s mission and core values.
  • Exceptional Self Awareness: Practices self-awareness at work, understanding that it is foundational to leading self, leading people, and leading results; uses reflection, self-understanding, and feedback to grow, and persist through challenges, and as a result, are cognizant of the impact of their behavior on others, and intentional about the decision to adjust or not adjust their behaviors. Displays an owner’s mindset by taking ownership of successes and failure.
  • Commitment to Continuous Learning: Engages in the work of personal development at working, knowing that personal development is ongoing and vital to their personal and professional success; hold themselves accountable to evolving, growing, learning and unlearning in ways that improve results for students, adults, and the larger community.

Core Skills:

  • Partnership and Alliance Building: Can generate enthusiasm, Investment and commitments, with internal and external stakeholders, to advance KIPP's mission
  • Stellar, Compelling Written & Oral Communication: Effectively tailors communications and engagement approach for different audiences to deepen investment and drive actions and behavior change that would lead to org-wide goals.
  • Effective Collaboration: Has the interpersonal, diplomatic, relationship building, and communications skills needed to develop successful working relationships with diverse constituents to deliver results. Evolves and adapts plans and approach with diverse stakeholders to drive results.
  • Self-Management to Achieve Ambitious Goals: Demonstrated record of setting ambitious goals and achieving them with consistency. Invests in developing teammates’ skills and mindsets to address gaps in achieving team growth. Determines what quantitative and qualitative data are most relevant to their goals and supports the team in creating and monitoring systems for collecting, reviewing, and acting upon data to drive outcomes; able to monitor progress, communicating status to the right stakeholders and adjusting plans and use of time to ensure systems are yielding desired outcomes.
  • Strong Problem Solving: Addresses the root of problems and removes obstacles from work. Shows initiative in generating and recommending ideas and solutions within their own workstreams. Anticipates risks and develops proactive solutions that support their team.

Experience and Qualifications
• Prior experience working with first-generation college students and/or students (K-12 or college) navigating economic barriers
• 7 or more years building & managing a portfolio of partnerships – preferably with colleges/universities or charter schools across a multi-state territory
• At least 2 years building and maintaining MOUs or institutional agreements
• Demonstrated experience using data to identify trends, inform decisions, and drive outcomes
• Strong record of success setting and reaching ambitious goals
• Record of success working cross-functionally, with a diverse array of stakeholders, to implement initiatives and reach goals

• Bachelor’s Degree required

Work Conditions

  • Extensive Travel: ~30-50% (65-110 days per year)

  • Some evening or weekend work (ex: evening events/functions; weekend conferences) occasionally required

  • Full-Time, Exempt

Location

Remote, with strong, but not required, preference to live in California or Colorado.

Compensation and Benefits

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, and relevant experience. The salary range for this position is $124,800 - $150,000. In addition, KIPP Foundation provides a variety of benefits to employees, including: 

  • 25 holidays for + 18 days additional flexible PTO days (flexible PTO increases to 23 days for years 3 and 4 and to 28 days for years 5+).

  • 100% paid parental leave

  • 100% coverage of the premium for employee and 75% for employee + family’s medical/dental/vision plans.

  • Wellness benefits such as fitness reimbursements, discounted tickets to theme parks/attractions, backup care support for children and adults/elders, and our employee assistance program

  • Finance Security benefits include such as a 401K retirement plan with 4% match, employer-sponsored legal plans, life/disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts

Application Guidelines

Apply by September 14, 2026.

About the Organization

KIPP Public Schools is a national network of tuition-free public charter schools that prepares students with the skills and confidence to create the future they want for themselves, their communities, and us all. We are a network of 279 schools, nearly 16,500 educators, and nearly 210,000 students and alumni.

Our mission: Together with families and communities, we create joyful, academically excellent schools that prepare students with the skills and confidence to pursue the paths they choose—college, career, and beyond—so they can lead fulfilling lives and build a more just world.

Our vision: Every child grows up free to create the future they want for themselves and their communities.

The KIPP Foundation is a nonprofit organization that supports KIPP public charter schools across the country. The KIPP Foundation helps to develop outstanding educators to lead KIPP schools; provides tools and resources for excellent teaching and learning; promotes innovation; and facilitates the exchange of insights and ideas across KIPP and other public schools and organizations.

About Our Values:

Excellent Results for Students: We value results over effort and know that our work is not finished until all students thrive. We maintain high expectations for self, team, and students. We drive outcomes by operating with agility, removing barriers, differentiating support, and prioritizing student-centered solutions—especially for those at the margins.

Collective Impact: We are one team. We win together. We embody a one-team mindset by working collaboratively across teams, aligning goals, and leveraging the strengths of all teammates. We build trust-based relationships and ensure inclusive decision-making by engaging those closest to the work. We provide clarity through simple, repeatable systems and goals that enable transformational outcomes.

Courageous Action: Our belief in what we can achieve is unwavering, fueling our optimism and commitment to overcome any challenge. We demonstrate an unwavering belief in students' potential and a commitment to addressing systemic inequities. We approach challenges with resilience, a solutions-focused mindset, and adaptability. We foster a psychologically safe environment centered on trust and accountability where feedback is encouraged. We leverage data to reflect on progress, own setbacks, celebrate successes, and continuously improve to maximize impact.

Crum & Forster Company Overview

Crum & Forster (C&F), with a proud history dating to 1822, provides specialty and standard commercial lines insurance products through our admitted and surplus lines insurance companies. C&F enjoys a financial strength rating of "A+" (Superior) by AM Best and is proud of our superior customer service platform. Our claims and risk engineering services are recognized as among the best in the industry.

Our most valuable asset is our people: more than 2000 employees in locations throughout the United States. The company is increasingly winning recognition as a great place to work, earning several workplace and wellness awards, including the 2025 Great Place to Work® Award for our employee-first focus and our steadfast commitment to diversity, equity and Inclusion.

C&F is part of Fairfax Financial Holdings, a global, billion dollar organization. For more information about Crum & Forster, please visit our website: www.cfins.com.

Job Description

The Executive Claims Specialist will handle a regular pending of primary and excess Directors and Officers and Financial Institution claims. These claims involve a high degree of technical evaluation and often include complex issues, including determining coverage and assessing potential exposure in a timely and accurate manner. The Executive Specialist shall aggressively analyze, assess and resolve cases from a coverage determination through ultimate resolution (including through litigation or negotiation). There may be an opportunity to work on other lines in the future depending on the needs of the company and other factors. This position will report to a Manager in the Financial Lines Claims group.

This position has a flexible workplace location, with the ability to work nearly exclusively remote or with a hybrid remote/in-person attendance in Jersey City, NJ, Morristown, NJ, Chicago, IL or any other C&F office nationwide.

What you will do:

  • Accountable for the full handling and control of all claim matters assigned from inception to resolution including: timely coverage analysis and letter writing; investigation; incident response, evaluation; reserve adequacy and timeliness; diary maintenance; management of defense and coverage counsel; reinsurance reporting; and claim disposition. The handling of these claims may require the occasional in-person attendance at mediations, settlement conferences and trials nationwide.
  • Consistent prompt evaluation of potential exposure present as to all claims assigned as well as an ability to adapt to changing circumstances as claims develop. An ability to segregate potentially significant claims possessing considerable exposure from straightforward claims. Ability to consider and formulate a possible resolution strategy at the earliest possible opportunity, including setting appropriate and timely reserves and communicating with defense counsel, insureds, coverage counsel or others to successfully achieve such strategy.
  • Claim presentations, both written and oral, will be required on a regular and timely basis to bring management up to speed, obtain authority and/or formulate appropriate action plans on claims that present the risk for considerable exposure.
  • Superior customer service to all co-employees, agents, policyholders and others encountered during the claims handling process is expected.
  • When needed, the Executive Specialist is expected to market claim services, update underwriting department personnel on claims trends, and coordinate and participate in presentations to industry personnel, including brokers and insureds.
  • Attend industry conferences depending on the needs of C&F.
  • May work on special projects, as assigned.

What you will bring to C&F:

  • Preferably at least six years handling Directors and Officers and/or Financial Institutions claims.
  • Juris doctor preferred but not required.
  • Experience handling crime matters and/or private company directors and officers claims is very helpful.
  • Experience handling employment practices liability, fiduciary and/or professional liability claims is helpful.
  • Must possess or be capable of obtaining multiple state adjuster licenses.
  • Demonstrated superior communication skills.
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills and the ability to deal effectively with support staff, claims staff, underwriting peers, policyholders and senior management.
  • Travel required up to 20%.
  • Excellent organizational abilities.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office suite of programs.
  • Overall positive outlook and approach.
  • Ability to multi-task when facing diverse responsibilities.

What C&F will bring to you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous 401K employer match
  • Employee Stock Purchase plan with employer matching
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Excellent benefits that go beyond health, dental & vision. Our programs are focused on your whole family’s wellness, including your physical, mental and financial wellbeing
  • A core C&F tenet is owning your career development, so we provide a wealth of ways for you to keep learning, including tuition reimbursement, industry-related certifications and professional training to keep you progressing on your chosen path
  • A dynamic, ambitious, fun and exciting work environment
  • We believe you do well by doing good and want to encourage a spirit of social and community responsibility, matching donation program, volunteer opportunities, and an employee-driven corporate giving program that lets you participate and support your community

At C&F you will BELONG

If you require special accommodations, please let us know. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and welcome everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. If you require special accommodations, please let us know. Belonging at C&F, is a mindset. It’s about fostering a culture of inclusion and connection, where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to thrive and where our social impact efforts help strengthen the communities where we live and work.

For California Residents Only: Information collected and processed as part of your career profile and any job applications you choose to submit are subject to our privacy notices and policies, visit for more information.

Crum & Forster is committed to ensuring a workplace free from discriminatory pay disparities and complying with applicable pay equity laws. Salary ranges are available for all positions at this location, taking into account roles with a comparable level of responsibility and impact in the relevant labor market and these salary ranges are regularly reviewed and adjusted in accordance with prevailing market conditions. The annualized base pay for the advertised position, located in the specified area, ranges from a minimum of $95,600.00 to a maximum of $179,600.00. The actual compensation is determined by various factors, including but not limited to the market pay for the jobs at each level, the responsibilities and skills required for each job, and the employee’s contribution (performance) in that role. To be considered within market range, a salary is at or above the minimum of the range. You may also have the opportunity to participate in discretionary equity (stock) based compensation and/or performance-based variable pay programs.

The Senior Infrastructure Engineer (AWS) is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting robust AWS-based infrastructure solutions for Catalight. This role requires deep hands-on expertise across cloud services, networking, automation, and container platforms, with a strong focus on reliability, security, and operational excellence. As a senior member of the team, you are expected to demonstrate independent discovery and leadership, mentoring other engineers while operating self-sufficiently in complex environments to support our mission of transforming home and community-based care.

Essential Job Functions

Cloud Infrastructure & Networking

  • Implement AWS infrastructure components such as VPCs, subnets, and routing.
  • Assist with hybrid connectivity (VPN, private endpoints, Transit Gateway).
  • Support high availability and basic disaster recovery configurations.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation

  • Use Terraform to provision and manage infrastructure.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployments.
  • Assist with basic automation tasks.

Containers & Orchestration

Community oriented:

raw.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Who We Are

ERPA empowers organizations to modernize critical enterprise systems and move forward with confidence. For more than 25 years, we have helped over 1,000 higher education, government, and commercial organizations navigate complex business and technology transformations through a requirements-driven approach focused on measurable outcomes.

With deep expertise across Workday, PeopleSoft, and Amazon Web Services, ERPA delivers deployment, cloud modernization, application management, optimization, and advisory services across the full technology lifecycle. Through transparent guidance and long-term partnership, we help clients reduce risk, simplify complexity, and maximize the value of their technology investments.

Where We Are Growing

ERPA is expanding its Solutions team and seeking an experienced Proposal Manager to lead the development of compelling, compliant, and differentiated responses to requests for proposals, information, and qualifications, including RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and related sales opportunities.

Reporting to the AVP, Solutions, this highly visible role partners closely with Sales, Delivery, technical and functional consultants, recruiting, and executive leadership. The Proposal Manager will own the proposal development lifecycle, from partnering with Sales on the initial opportunity assessment and kickoff through final production and submission, while keeping contributors aligned, content accurate, and deadlines on track.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized, detail-oriented self-starter who understands how enterprise SaaS solutions are sold, deployed, and managed. Candidates should have experience developing proposals for Workday deployments or comparable SaaS solutions, preferably within HCM, Financial Management, or Student Information Systems.

Success in this role requires more than coordinating documents. You must be able to partner with Sales and Delivery to understand client requirements, facilitate solution-development discussions, translate technical and functional concepts into clear business value, and articulate why ERPA is the right partner. You will also help modernize ERPA’s proposal operations by maintaining reusable proposal content and applying AI tools responsibly to improve quality, consistency, and efficiency.

The Proposal Manager will embody ERPA’s core values: Empathy, Responsibility, Passion, and Agility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead all stages of the proposal development lifecycle, including partnering with sales on opportunity assessment, kickoff, response planning, content development, reviews, production, approval, and final submission.
  • Review and analyze public-sector, higher education, and commercial RFx documents to identify requirements, evaluation criteria, submission instructions, risks, dependencies, and compliance obligations.
  • Develop proposal schedules, responsibility matrices, content plans, and review milestones, ensuring contributors remain accountable and deadlines are met.
  • Partner with Sales, Delivery, recruiting, legal, finance, and executive stakeholders to develop accurate and persuasive proposal content, and address requirements accurately and compliantly.
  • Attend and support solutioning sessions that align ERPA’s proposed approach, staffing model, deployment methodology, differentiators, and value proposition with the client’s needs.
  • Translate technical and functional information into clear, concise, customer-focused narratives that are understandable to both business and technical audiences.
  • Draft, edit, and refine proposal content while integrating contributions from multiple authors into a consistent and compelling “one voice” response.
  • Manage proposal compliance, including templates, page limits, required forms, certifications, attachments, formatting requirements, and submission instructions.
  • Prepare and coordinate questions, assumptions, exceptions, and requests for clarification for submission to prospective clients.
  • Identify gaps, risks, and constraints during proposal development and proactively recommend solutions or escalation paths.
  • Lead proposal status meetings and communicate progress, decisions, risks, and action items to contributors, leadership, and other key stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Recruiting and Delivery leadership to confirm that proposed staffing, qualifications, résumés, and resource assumptions support the proposed solution.
  • Maintain and continuously improve ERPA’s proposal boilerplate and content repository, including company information, service descriptions, methodologies, case studies, résumés, project examples, and standard responses.
  • Establish processes for content ownership, review cycles, version control, tagging, and retirement of outdated or duplicative proposal materials.
  • Use AI tools, Claude, to support research, content development, editing, summarization, compliance reviews, and content reuse, while validating all outputs for accuracy, confidentiality, tone, and quality.
  • Participate in proposal retrospectives and apply lessons learned to improve future win strategies, content, tools, and processes.
  • Support additional sales-enablement and pursuit activities as business needs require.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • At least five (5) years of proposal management or proposal development experience supporting government, public-sector, higher education, and/or commercial opportunities.
  • Demonstrated experience developing deployment and/or Application Management Services (AMS)/managed services proposals for Workday or similar enterprise SaaS solutions, involving HCM, Financial Management, Student Information Systems, or related business platforms.
  • Proven ability to independently manage multiple complex proposals and competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated success coordinating cross-functional teams that include sales, technical, functional, delivery, recruiting, contracts, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong technical and functional acumen, with the ability to understand implementation approaches, deployment methodologies, staffing models, integrations, data conversion, testing, change management, and other common SaaS delivery concepts.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, proofreading, and document-management skills, with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Experience maintaining reusable proposal content, boilerplate libraries, or knowledge repositories.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools, such as ChatGPT or Claude, to improve proposal-development efficiency and quality.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, including styles, section management, tables, references, captions, headers and footers, and complex document formatting.
  • Experience with PowerPoint and/or Canva in presentation development is desired.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Acrobat Pro, including editing, combining, organizing, and quality-checking PDF files.
  • Excellent verbal communication, facilitation, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to handle confidential and sensitive business information appropriately.
  • Familiarity with structured proposal methodologies, color-team reviews, compliance matrices, storyboarding, and win-theme development.
  • Understanding of enterprise software deployment methodologies and the professional-services sales lifecycle.
  • Experience contributing to proposal-process transformation or continuous-improvement initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Proposal Manager at ERPA will:

  • Deliver complete, compliant, polished proposals on time.
  • Improve the clarity and consistency of ERPA’s proposal messaging.
  • Keep diverse stakeholder groups aligned and accountable throughout each pursuit.
  • Build a reliable, current, and easily searchable library of reusable proposal content.
  • Apply AI thoughtfully to accelerate proposal development without compromising accuracy, confidentiality, or quality.
  • Strengthen ERPA’s ability to communicate differentiated solutions and win strategic opportunities.

What We Offer

  • A values-driven culture grounded in Empathy, Responsibility, Passion, and Agility
  • Remote work opportunity
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • 401(k) plan with a strong company match

raw.description:
About Megaport

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

Our Team Culture

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

The Role

Reporting to the Director of Network Strategy, the Data Centre Procurement Officer supports data centre strategy, procurement, and commercial activities across the Americas.

Working closely with the Director of Data Centre Strategy and regional colleagues across EMEA and APAC, the role supports Megaport’s global data centre footprint through commercial analysis, market intelligence, supplier management, business cases, and negotiations.

You will work with Network Engineering, Finance, Sales, Operations, and other stakeholders to evaluate opportunities, optimise costs, and support the delivery of a scalable and commercially efficient data centre strategy.

The role will build strong knowledge of Megaport’s data centre footprint, suppliers, and active initiatives, providing continuity across data centre activities while supporting expansion across the Americas and the wider global network.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Support data centre strategy, procurement, and commercial activities across the Americas, including North America and Latin America.

  • Work closely with the Director of Data Centre Strategy and regional colleagues across EMEA and APAC.

  • Analyse and prepare business cases to support data centre expansion, optimisation, and other strategic initiatives.

  • Support supplier negotiations and manage commercial discussions with data centre operators and infrastructure partners.

  • Contribute to the development of the annual cost of goods sold (COGS) budget.

  • Collaborate with Finance to prepare monthly COGS reporting, including value-added commentary.

  • Provide monthly reporting on key performance indicators relating to data centre and network costs.

  • Engage with Network Engineering and Operations teams to support data centre strategy and network expansion.

  • Maintain market intelligence on data centre operators, facilities, pricing, and industry developments.

  • Maintain accurate procurement, supplier, contract, and commercial records.

  • Support special projects and strategic initiatives as directed by management.

What We're Looking For

  • A minimum of 2 years’ experience in procurement, vendor management, business development, telecommunications, data centres, or a related field.

  • Experience managing contracts and suppliers, ideally across multiple vendors or regions.

  • Commercial understanding of data centre services, colocation, network transport, internet transit, or related telecommunications infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with networking concepts and technologies preferred.

  • Confidence reviewing contractual terms and engaging with suppliers on commercial discussions and negotiations.

  • Strong analytical and financial skills, with experience in budgeting, business cases, or cost analysis.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities with strong attention to detail.

  • Proven ability to work independently, take ownership of activities, and work effectively across different time zones.

What We Offer

  • Flexible working environment – a remote-first culture with coworking options available.
  • Generous leave plans – including 4 weeks of paid annual leave, parental leave, birthday leave, and a purchased annual leave program.
  • Health and wellness support – through a wellness allowance and employee wellbeing initiatives.
  • Comprehensive learning support – generous study and training allowance plus 5 days of paid study leave
  • Creative, modern workspaces – designed to inspire when you're not working remotely
  • Motivated, inclusive team – work alongside industry experts and fresh talent
  • Recognition programs – celebrate achievements with our Legend and Kudos awards
If you have any questions, please reach out to Megaport's Talent Acquisition Team at
NOTE: All Megaport business correspondence is conducted via our business email accounts (@megaport.com). If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under "@megaportau.com".
All applications will be treated in confidence.
Please see Part 2 of our Privacy Policy to see what information Megaport collects from job applicants, why, and how we store and use it. raw.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $90/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.
