Crum & Forster Company Overview

Crum & Forster (C&F), with a proud history dating to 1822, provides specialty and standard commercial lines insurance products through our admitted and surplus lines insurance companies. C&F enjoys a financial strength rating of "A+" (Superior) by AM Best and is proud of our superior customer service platform. Our claims and risk engineering services are recognized as among the best in the industry.

Our most valuable asset is our people: more than 2000 employees in locations throughout the United States. The company is increasingly winning recognition as a great place to work, earning several workplace and wellness awards, including the 2025 Great Place to Work® Award for our employee-first focus and our steadfast commitment to diversity, equity and Inclusion.

C&F is part of Fairfax Financial Holdings, a global, billion dollar organization. For more information about Crum & Forster, please visit our website: www.cfins.com.

Job Description

The Executive Claims Specialist will handle a regular pending of primary and excess Directors and Officers and Financial Institution claims. These claims involve a high degree of technical evaluation and often include complex issues, including determining coverage and assessing potential exposure in a timely and accurate manner. The Executive Specialist shall aggressively analyze, assess and resolve cases from a coverage determination through ultimate resolution (including through litigation or negotiation). There may be an opportunity to work on other lines in the future depending on the needs of the company and other factors. This position will report to a Manager in the Financial Lines Claims group.

This position has a flexible workplace location, with the ability to work nearly exclusively remote or with a hybrid remote/in-person attendance in Jersey City, NJ, Morristown, NJ, Chicago, IL or any other C&F office nationwide.

What you will do:

  • Accountable for the full handling and control of all claim matters assigned from inception to resolution including: timely coverage analysis and letter writing; investigation; incident response, evaluation; reserve adequacy and timeliness; diary maintenance; management of defense and coverage counsel; reinsurance reporting; and claim disposition. The handling of these claims may require the occasional in-person attendance at mediations, settlement conferences and trials nationwide.
  • Consistent prompt evaluation of potential exposure present as to all claims assigned as well as an ability to adapt to changing circumstances as claims develop. An ability to segregate potentially significant claims possessing considerable exposure from straightforward claims. Ability to consider and formulate a possible resolution strategy at the earliest possible opportunity, including setting appropriate and timely reserves and communicating with defense counsel, insureds, coverage counsel or others to successfully achieve such strategy.
  • Claim presentations, both written and oral, will be required on a regular and timely basis to bring management up to speed, obtain authority and/or formulate appropriate action plans on claims that present the risk for considerable exposure.
  • Superior customer service to all co-employees, agents, policyholders and others encountered during the claims handling process is expected.
  • When needed, the Executive Specialist is expected to market claim services, update underwriting department personnel on claims trends, and coordinate and participate in presentations to industry personnel, including brokers and insureds.
  • Attend industry conferences depending on the needs of C&F.
  • May work on special projects, as assigned.

What you will bring to C&F:

  • Preferably at least six years handling Directors and Officers and/or Financial Institutions claims.

  • Experience handling crime matters and/or private company directors and officers claims is very helpful.

  • Demonstrated superior communication skills.
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills and the ability to deal effectively with support staff, claims staff, underwriting peers, policyholders and senior management.
  • Travel required up to 20%.
  • Excellent organizational abilities.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office suite of programs.
  • Overall positive outlook and approach.
  • Ability to multi-task when facing diverse responsibilities.

What C&F will bring to you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous 401K employer match
  • Employee Stock Purchase plan with employer matching
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Excellent benefits that go beyond health, dental & vision. Our programs are focused on your whole family’s wellness, including your physical, mental and financial wellbeing
  • A core C&F tenet is owning your career development, so we provide a wealth of ways for you to keep learning, including tuition reimbursement, industry-related certifications and professional training to keep you progressing on your chosen path
  • A dynamic, ambitious, fun and exciting work environment
  • We believe you do well by doing good and want to encourage a spirit of social and community responsibility, matching donation program, volunteer opportunities, and an employee-driven corporate giving program that lets you participate and support your community

At C&F you will BELONG

We are committed to equal employment opportunity and welcome everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. It’s about fostering a culture of inclusion and connection, where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to thrive and where our social impact efforts help strengthen the communities where we live and work.

raw.description:
The Senior Infrastructure Engineer (AWS) is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting robust AWS-based infrastructure solutions for Catalight. This role requires deep hands-on expertise across cloud services, networking, automation, and container platforms, with a strong focus on reliability, security, and operational excellence. As a senior member of the team, you are expected to demonstrate independent discovery and leadership, mentoring other engineers while operating self-sufficiently in complex environments to support our mission of transforming home and community-based care.

Essential Job Functions

Cloud Infrastructure & Networking

  • Implement AWS infrastructure components such as VPCs, subnets, and routing.
  • Assist with hybrid connectivity (VPN, private endpoints, Transit Gateway).
  • Support high availability and basic disaster recovery configurations.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation

  • Use Terraform to provision and manage infrastructure.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployments.
  • Assist with basic automation tasks.

Containers & Orchestration

  • Work with Docker to build and run containerized applications.
  • Support deployments in ECS or EKS environments.
  • Assist with scaling, health checks, and basic deployment strategies.

Monitoring & Observability

  • Use CloudWatch and Datadog for monitoring and alerting.
  • Support dashboards and basic alert configurations.
  • Assist in incident response and troubleshooting.

Collaboration & Support

  • Work with engineering teams to support deployments and operations.
  • Maintain documentation and runbooks.
  • Participate in issue resolution and team activities.

Qualifications

Minimum Education, Experience & Training Equivalent to:

We believe humans with a diverse range of experiences may be suited for the work at hand. We are avoiding education minimums with an acknowledgment that these can be barriers for historically excluded groups. We’re looking for someone who brings deep expertise in people-centered work and is excited to grow with us. This role is well suited for someone who has:

  • 4+ years of experience in cloud or infrastructure engineering.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS core services.
  • Familiarity with Terraform or similar.
  • Basic experience with Docker and container platforms.
  • Understanding of networking and cloud fundamentals.
  • Exposure to monitoring tools.

What would be a plus:

  • Exposure to CI/CD tools (e.g., GitLab).
  • Familiarity with APIs or integration patterns.
  • Experience supporting security reviews and compliance requirements (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Basic understanding of microservices.

Requests:

  • Must be able to communicate effectively within the work environment, read and write using the primary language within the workplace.
  • Visual and auditory ability to work with clients, staff and others in the workplace continuously.
  • Frequent speaking and listening (25-75%) to clients, staff, and others in the workplace.
  • Utilize computer and cell phone for effective communication.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (organized by our company values):

Community oriented:

  • Appreciates and demonstrates collaboration across teams.
  • Work in an exciting, fast paced high energy environment while effectively multitasking and managing day-to-day responsibilities without supervision.
  • Personable; able to work comfortably with individuals at all levels within the organization.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts.

Equity informed:

  • Approaches work with a growth mindset, welcome feedback, and understand that humans all have biases and are imperfect as a baseline.
  • Sensitivity to working with an ethnically, linguistically, culturally, and economically diverse population.

Bold:

  • Navigates ambiguity with an excitement for problem solving.
  • Willingness to learn and grow technical skills.
  • Commitment to meet agreed upon deadlines on time or ahead of schedule.
  • Transparent on action, pursuits, and outcomes.
  • A commitment to the values of the organization while demonstrating good judgment, flexibility, patience and discretion when dealing with confidential and sensitive matters.

raw.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Who We Are

ERPA empowers organizations to modernize critical enterprise systems and move forward with confidence. For more than 25 years, we have helped over 1,000 higher education, government, and commercial organizations navigate complex business and technology transformations through a requirements-driven approach focused on measurable outcomes.

With deep expertise across Workday, PeopleSoft, and Amazon Web Services, ERPA delivers deployment, cloud modernization, application management, optimization, and advisory services across the full technology lifecycle. Through transparent guidance and long-term partnership, we help clients reduce risk, simplify complexity, and maximize the value of their technology investments.

Where We Are Growing

ERPA is expanding its Solutions team and seeking an experienced Proposal Manager to lead the development of compelling, compliant, and differentiated responses to requests for proposals, information, and qualifications, including RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and related sales opportunities.

Reporting to the AVP, Solutions, this highly visible role partners closely with Sales, Delivery, technical and functional consultants, recruiting, and executive leadership. The Proposal Manager will own the proposal development lifecycle, from partnering with Sales on the initial opportunity assessment and kickoff through final production and submission, while keeping contributors aligned, content accurate, and deadlines on track.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized, detail-oriented self-starter who understands how enterprise SaaS solutions are sold, deployed, and managed. Candidates should have experience developing proposals for Workday deployments or comparable SaaS solutions, preferably within HCM, Financial Management, or Student Information Systems.

Success in this role requires more than coordinating documents. You must be able to partner with Sales and Delivery to understand client requirements, facilitate solution-development discussions, translate technical and functional concepts into clear business value, and articulate why ERPA is the right partner. You will also help modernize ERPA’s proposal operations by maintaining reusable proposal content and applying AI tools responsibly to improve quality, consistency, and efficiency.

The Proposal Manager will embody ERPA’s core values: Empathy, Responsibility, Passion, and Agility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead all stages of the proposal development lifecycle, including partnering with sales on opportunity assessment, kickoff, response planning, content development, reviews, production, approval, and final submission.
  • Review and analyze public-sector, higher education, and commercial RFx documents to identify requirements, evaluation criteria, submission instructions, risks, dependencies, and compliance obligations.
  • Develop proposal schedules, responsibility matrices, content plans, and review milestones, ensuring contributors remain accountable and deadlines are met.
  • Partner with Sales, Delivery, recruiting, legal, finance, and executive stakeholders to develop accurate and persuasive proposal content, and address requirements accurately and compliantly.
  • Attend and support solutioning sessions that align ERPA’s proposed approach, staffing model, deployment methodology, differentiators, and value proposition with the client’s needs.
  • Translate technical and functional information into clear, concise, customer-focused narratives that are understandable to both business and technical audiences.
  • Draft, edit, and refine proposal content while integrating contributions from multiple authors into a consistent and compelling “one voice” response.
  • Manage proposal compliance, including templates, page limits, required forms, certifications, attachments, formatting requirements, and submission instructions.
  • Prepare and coordinate questions, assumptions, exceptions, and requests for clarification for submission to prospective clients.
  • Identify gaps, risks, and constraints during proposal development and proactively recommend solutions or escalation paths.
  • Lead proposal status meetings and communicate progress, decisions, risks, and action items to contributors, leadership, and other key stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Recruiting and Delivery leadership to confirm that proposed staffing, qualifications, résumés, and resource assumptions support the proposed solution.
  • Maintain and continuously improve ERPA’s proposal boilerplate and content repository, including company information, service descriptions, methodologies, case studies, résumés, project examples, and standard responses.
  • Establish processes for content ownership, review cycles, version control, tagging, and retirement of outdated or duplicative proposal materials.
  • Use AI tools, Claude, to support research, content development, editing, summarization, compliance reviews, and content reuse, while validating all outputs for accuracy, confidentiality, tone, and quality.
  • Participate in proposal retrospectives and apply lessons learned to improve future win strategies, content, tools, and processes.
  • Support additional sales-enablement and pursuit activities as business needs require.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • At least five (5) years of proposal management or proposal development experience supporting government, public-sector, higher education, and/or commercial opportunities.
  • Demonstrated experience developing deployment and/or Application Management Services (AMS)/managed services proposals for Workday or similar enterprise SaaS solutions, involving HCM, Financial Management, Student Information Systems, or related business platforms.
  • Proven ability to independently manage multiple complex proposals and competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated success coordinating cross-functional teams that include sales, technical, functional, delivery, recruiting, contracts, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong technical and functional acumen, with the ability to understand implementation approaches, deployment methodologies, staffing models, integrations, data conversion, testing, change management, and other common SaaS delivery concepts.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, proofreading, and document-management skills, with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Experience maintaining reusable proposal content, boilerplate libraries, or knowledge repositories.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools, such as ChatGPT or Claude, to improve proposal-development efficiency and quality.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, including styles, section management, tables, references, captions, headers and footers, and complex document formatting.
  • Experience with PowerPoint and/or Canva in presentation development is desired.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Acrobat Pro, including editing, combining, organizing, and quality-checking PDF files.
  • Excellent verbal communication, facilitation, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to handle confidential and sensitive business information appropriately.
  • Familiarity with structured proposal methodologies, color-team reviews, compliance matrices, storyboarding, and win-theme development.
  • Understanding of enterprise software deployment methodologies and the professional-services sales lifecycle.
  • Experience contributing to proposal-process transformation or continuous-improvement initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Proposal Manager at ERPA will:

  • Deliver complete, compliant, polished proposals on time.
  • Improve the clarity and consistency of ERPA’s proposal messaging.
  • Keep diverse stakeholder groups aligned and accountable throughout each pursuit.
  • Build a reliable, current, and easily searchable library of reusable proposal content.
  • Apply AI thoughtfully to accelerate proposal development without compromising accuracy, confidentiality, or quality.
  • Strengthen ERPA’s ability to communicate differentiated solutions and win strategic opportunities.

What We Offer

  • A values-driven culture grounded in Empathy, Responsibility, Passion, and Agility
  • Remote work opportunity
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • 401(k) plan with a strong company match

raw.description:
About Megaport

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

Our Team Culture

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

The Role

Reporting to the Director of Network Strategy, the Data Centre Procurement Officer supports data centre strategy, procurement, and commercial activities across the Americas.

Working closely with the Director of Data Centre Strategy and regional colleagues across EMEA and APAC, the role supports Megaport’s global data centre footprint through commercial analysis, market intelligence, supplier management, business cases, and negotiations.

You will work with Network Engineering, Finance, Sales, Operations, and other stakeholders to evaluate opportunities, optimise costs, and support the delivery of a scalable and commercially efficient data centre strategy.

The role will build strong knowledge of Megaport’s data centre footprint, suppliers, and active initiatives, providing continuity across data centre activities while supporting expansion across the Americas and the wider global network.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Support data centre strategy, procurement, and commercial activities across the Americas, including North America and Latin America.

  • Work closely with the Director of Data Centre Strategy and regional colleagues across EMEA and APAC.

  • Analyse and prepare business cases to support data centre expansion, optimisation, and other strategic initiatives.

  • Support supplier negotiations and manage commercial discussions with data centre operators and infrastructure partners.

  • Contribute to the development of the annual cost of goods sold (COGS) budget.

  • Collaborate with Finance to prepare monthly COGS reporting, including value-added commentary.

  • Provide monthly reporting on key performance indicators relating to data centre and network costs.

  • Engage with Network Engineering and Operations teams to support data centre strategy and network expansion.

  • Maintain market intelligence on data centre operators, facilities, pricing, and industry developments.

  • Maintain accurate procurement, supplier, contract, and commercial records.

  • Support special projects and strategic initiatives as directed by management.

What We're Looking For

  • A minimum of 2 years’ experience in procurement, vendor management, business development, telecommunications, data centres, or a related field.

  • Experience managing contracts and suppliers, ideally across multiple vendors or regions.

  • Commercial understanding of data centre services, colocation, network transport, internet transit, or related telecommunications infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with networking concepts and technologies preferred.

  • Confidence reviewing contractual terms and engaging with suppliers on commercial discussions and negotiations.

  • Strong analytical and financial skills, with experience in budgeting, business cases, or cost analysis.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities with strong attention to detail.

  • Proven ability to work independently, take ownership of activities, and work effectively across different time zones.

What We Offer

  • Flexible working environment – a remote-first culture with coworking options available.
  • Generous leave plans – including 4 weeks of paid annual leave, parental leave, birthday leave, and a purchased annual leave program.
  • Health and wellness support – through a wellness allowance and employee wellbeing initiatives.
  • Comprehensive learning support – generous study and training allowance plus 5 days of paid study leave
  • Creative, modern workspaces – designed to inspire when you're not working remotely
  • Motivated, inclusive team – work alongside industry experts and fresh talent
  • Recognition programs – celebrate achievements with our Legend and Kudos awards

raw.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $90/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

The Company

We’re Octopus Legacy: one of the fastest growing tech companies in the country, part of the UK’s most exciting and best-trusted group (you may have heard of some of our sister companies…) and we have a mission.

We’re on a path to scale, aiming to become a household name while transforming a long-established industry and helping our customers prepare for, and find support after, death.

We are seeking a dedicated Estate Planning Consultant who will be responsible for conducting home visits to assist clients in the process of drafting and creating wills. You will take the time to discuss your clients requirements in detail, explaining how the use of wills, trusts and lasting powers of attorney can work to protect them, their estate and their loved ones. The ideal candidate will excel in providing personalised and comprehensive guidance to individuals and families, ensuring their wishes are accurately documented whilst showing compassion and care.

Our Mission

When people think about planning for death they think about wills, life insurance and funerals. We take these cold processes and turn them into something more human. Share more than money: leave voice notes, music, recipes. Shape a legacy that connects you while you're here. And after you're gone.

Founded by Sam after his mum died suddenly, we’re a group of people who work in death because we’ve been affected by it. We know the difference a good plan makes, and what it’s like when there isn’t one.

Death can come between us, leave mess, legal fees, frustration. But it can also make us stronger. We see a world where people talk openly about death, and work out the real meaning of legacy, one that connects to them. We’re here to make that world happen.

If you enjoy building relationships, managing multiple searches, and delivering exceptional hiring outcomes, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Full-Cycle Recruitment

  • Own the recruitment process from intake through successful placement.
  • Conduct kickoff meetings to understand hiring goals, role requirements, and ideal candidate profiles.
  • Develop sourcing strategies for each search.
  • Source candidates using:
    • LinkedIn Recruiter
    • Job boards
    • Internal talent pools
    • Professional networks
  • Screen resumes and conduct structured interviews.
  • Evaluate:
    • Skills
    • Experience
    • Communication
    • Cultural fit
  • Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines across multiple open roles.

Candidate Management

  • Guide candidates through every stage of the hiring process.
  • Ensure every candidate completes a full application package before client submission, including:
    • Updated resume
    • Screening interview
    • Salary expectations
    • Availability and notice period
    • Introductory video
    • Required assessments (when applicable)
    • Additional client-requested documentation
  • Follow up proactively to ensure timely completion of hiring requirements.
  • Prepare candidates for client interviews.
  • Maintain consistent communication from first contact through onboarding.
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.

Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
  • Provide regular hiring updates and market insights.
  • Present only fully qualified and thoroughly vetted candidates.
  • Coordinate interview scheduling and collect client feedback.
  • Manage offers, negotiations, onboarding, and successful placements.
  • Build long-term client relationships that encourage repeat business.

Recruitment Operations

  • Maintain accurate records in ATS and CRM systems.
  • Track candidate progress across every stage of the hiring process.
  • Keep hiring pipelines organized and up to date.
  • Meet hiring timelines while maintaining high-quality standards.
  • Continuously improve recruitment workflows and candidate experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • High-quality candidates are presented quickly.
  • Hiring timelines are consistently met.
  • Clients receive proactive communication and exceptional service.
  • Candidates remain engaged throughout the hiring process.
  • Recruitment pipelines stay organized and accurate.
  • Placements lead to long-term client satisfaction and repeat business.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You enjoy owning the hiring process from beginning to end.
  • You’re highly organized and comfortable managing multiple searches simultaneously.
  • You’re an excellent interviewer with strong talent assessment skills.
  • You communicate clearly with both clients and candidates.
  • You’re proactive, responsive, and committed to delivering exceptional hiring experiences.
  • You build long-term relationships through trust, consistency, and results.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in:
    • Full-cycle recruitment
    • Talent acquisition
    • Agency recruiting
  • Experience managing multiple hiring processes simultaneously.
  • Strong experience sourcing, interviewing, and evaluating candidates.
  • Experience working directly with U.S.-based clients.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong interviewing and relationship-building abilities.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.

Technical Skills

  • LinkedIn Recruiter
  • Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)
  • CRM platforms
  • Google Workspace
  • Zoom

Nice to Have

  • Experience recruiting for:
    • Technical roles
    • Sales
    • Operations
    • Executive leadership
  • Agency or staffing industry experience.
  • Experience recruiting remote global talent.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered recruiting and sourcing tools.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Meet with clients to discuss hiring priorities and open positions.
  • Source and screen candidates across multiple recruiting channels.
  • Conduct interviews and evaluate candidate fit.
  • Prepare complete candidate packages for client review.
  • Coordinate interviews and gather hiring feedback.
  • Update ATS and CRM records.
  • Manage offers, negotiations, and onboarding activities.
  • Provide hiring updates and market insights to clients.

In short: You’ll manage the entire recruitment lifecycle, helping clients hire exceptional talent while delivering an outstanding experience for every candidate.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Time to present qualified candidates.
  • Time to fill.
  • Number of successful placements.
  • Candidate response and engagement rates.
  • Application package completion rate.
  • Interview-to-offer ratio.
  • Offer acceptance rate.
  • Client satisfaction.
  • Candidate satisfaction.
  • Recruitment pipeline accuracy.

Why Join Pavago?

  • Own the complete recruitment lifecycle for a diverse portfolio of U.S. clients.
  • Build lasting relationships with both clients and candidates.
  • Work in a collaborative, fast-growing remote environment.
  • Gain exposure to hiring across multiple industries and functions.
  • Opportunity to grow into:
    • Senior Account Manager
    • Talent Acquisition Lead
    • Recruiting Manager
    • Client Success Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of an initial screening call, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your recruiting experience, and explain how you’ve managed full-cycle hiring, built candidate pipelines, partnered with clients, and successfully filled roles. You’ll also have the chance to highlight your approach to candidate experience, stakeholder communication, and recruitment operations. Your video will be reviewed by our recruitment team before moving forward to the interview stage.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about full-cycle recruiting, enjoy building strong client relationships, and thrive on helping companies hire exceptional talent, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become a key partner in delivering world-class hiring experiences.

raw.description:
Partner One est un groupe d’investissement à long terme spécialisé dans l’acquisition et le développement d’entreprises de logiciels performantes. Forte de plus de 30 ans d’expérience, l’organisation détient et exploite certaines des entreprises de logiciels d’entreprise à la croissance la plus rapide à l’échelle mondiale. Plus de 2 000 des plus grandes entreprises et administrations publiques dans le monde s’appuient sur nos solutions logicielles pour leurs opérations les plus critiques et pour protéger leurs données les plus précieuses.

Nous recherchons actuellement un(e) Associé(e) en fusions et acquisitions (M&A) pour rejoindre notre équipe dans le cadre d’un poste permanent, à temps plein et entièrement à distance.

L’Associé(e) en M&A fera partie de l’équipe Fusions et Acquisitions et jouera un rôle clé dans le soutien aux activités de recherche, d’évaluation, de diligence raisonnable et d’exécution des acquisitions, tout en étant exposé(e) à un volume élevé d’opportunités actives.

Responsabilités

  • Identifier et sourcer des entreprises de logiciels répondant à nos critères d’acquisition ainsi qu’à nos principaux indicateurs de performance
  • Développer et exécuter des campagnes de prospection ciblées par courriel et par appels sortants, tout en testant en continu de nouvelles stratégies de développement des affaires, avec une exposition à un volume élevé d’opportunités de transactions
  • Établir et entretenir des relations avec des cibles d’acquisition potentielles ainsi qu’avec des banques d’investissement spécialisées en fusions et acquisitions (sell-side)
  • Mener des évaluations préliminaires des acquisitions potentielles, incluant une première analyse opérationnelle et financière, ainsi que l’évaluation des opportunités et des risques
  • Gérer et piloter un pipeline de transactions robuste, en assurant sa mise à jour continue au fur et à mesure que de nouvelles cibles et informations émergent, tout en collaborant avec une équipe entrepreneuriale, performante et motivée
  • Réaliser des analyses sectorielles et des recherches de marché afin d’identifier les tendances et de repérer de nouvelles opportunités d’acquisition
  • Examiner et analyser les documents d’investissement, en synthétisant de grands volumes de données en analyses, présentations et recommandations claires, concises et exploitables
  • Faire progresser de manière autonome les opportunités d’acquisition en maîtrisant le périmètre des transactions et en maintenant l’élan tout au long du processus, avec une exposition à l’ensemble du cycle de vie des transactions, de la prospection à l’exécution
  • Prioriser et déléguer efficacement les tâches en fonction des échéanciers des transactions et de leur importance stratégique
  • Fournir un soutien analytique et opérationnel ad hoc à l’ensemble de l’équipe, selon les besoins
  • Collaborer de manière transversale afin de soutenir les demandes de données, la diligence raisonnable, l’alignement interne et l’exécution réussie des transactions

Requirements

Exigences

  • 2 à 3 ans d’expérience en banque d’investissement, capital‑investissement (Private Equity) ou développement corporatif requis
  • Une expérience préalable en transactions de fusions et acquisitions dans le secteur des logiciels est essentielle
  • Excellents résultats académiques obtenus au sein d’un établissement de premier plan
  • Diplôme de premier cycle en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe, un atout
  • Maturité professionnelle et aisance dans les interactions avec des dirigeants de niveau C (C‑suite)
  • Profil très proactif, autonome et motivé, avec de solides compétences en vente et en communication
  • Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles et potentiel démontré en leadership
  • Base solide en principes comptables et en modélisation financière
  • Bonne compréhension des modèles d’affaires des entreprises de logiciels et du cycle de vie des transactions M&A
  • Fortes capacités analytiques, sens aigu de la reconnaissance des tendances et maîtrise avancée d’Excel

Fourchette salariale de base : 80 000 $ à 90 000 $ CAD par année

Commission : Structure de commission additionnelle offerte

The ServiceNow Brand Strategy and Creative team is a passionate group of creative thinkers responsible for shaping the future of the ServiceNow brand. We're looking for an Associate Creative Director of Motion Design to help define and evolve how our brand moves—across every channel and touchpoint, internal and external.

In this role, you are both a maker and a leader, a designer and animator with expert command of motion and design principles including keyframes, timing, and visual systems. You demonstrate strong ownership and are fueled by a passion to create beautifully animated work. You are adept at interpreting the core objectives of the brief and can translate them into non-linear creative solutions that deliver for the customer with bias for action. You are a strategic thinker and bring a point of view to your work providing clear, effective direction to artists and agencies. You field and reconcile feedback from leadership with judgment and composure, staying sharp under pressure while managing multiple workstreams. You bring a growth mindset that thrives in ambiguity and welcomes new ways of working.

Reporting to the Creative Director of Motion Design and partnering with brand leadership, you'll lead creative development and execution across some of our highest impact brand events and initiatives. You invite collaboration and partner closely with internal teams, freelancers, and external agencies to bring world-class motion design to life.

Responsibilities:

  • Own motion design projects end-to-end, from brief through delivery, across major brand initiatives, campaigns, and tier-one events- driving them independently while keeping the creative director and leadership updated.

  • Bring a strong creative point of view to every workstream, helping to define the vision, and setting the standard for executional excellence.

  • Design and animate directly, especially for key initiatives that require hands-on creative leadership.

  • Maintain and evolve our brand motion language, ensuring consistency and craft across events, market launches, and core brand touchpoints. Scale motion systems and workflows by contributing to standards, templates, toolkits, and best practices.

  • Manage multiple projects and programs in parallel, staying composed and effective under pressure and tight deadlines.

  • Field and reconcile feedback from leadership, exercising judgment to translate input into a clear creative path forward.

  • Direct, mentor, and provide clear, effective direction and feedback to motion designers, freelancers, and agency partners, raising the bar across all motion output.

  • Partner cross-functionally with brand, marketing, product, and creative teams to align motion work with broader storytelling and business goals.

  • Communicate effectively across creative peers, project management, strategy, senior leadership, and business partners, aligning stakeholders around a creative vision and knowing when to ask the right questions.

  • Explore and integrate AI-driven tools and techniques to expand what's possible and improve how the team works.

  • 10+ years of experience in motion design and creative direction, including prior leadership running workstreams and directing others. A strong creative point of view, with the ability to field and reconcile leadership feedback and provide clear direction to others.

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong design and typography fundamentals, a range of styles, and a diversity of project types.

  • Mastery of motion and design principles, timing, keyframes, and visual systems, with fluency in speed and value curves.

  • Expert knowledge of relevant tools, including After Effects, Cinema 4D, Redshift, and Figma, along with modern motion workflows.

  • Experience working on tier-one brand moments such as global events, major campaigns, or product launches.

  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills. Can develop project and initiative presentations from strategy to execution. Able to align stakeholders around a creative vision and ask smart questions that move work forward.

  • Proven ability to run multiple projects and programs in parallel, prioritize effectively, and deliver under pressure and tight deadlines. Strong time management and composure across competing priorities.

  • Demonstrated people management experience, coaching and developing team members and directing contractors and external agencies.

  • Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into creative processes, decision-making, or problem-solving.

Our culture of service enables us to form long-lasting and trusted partnerships, while our focus on creativity and innovative solutions empowers our customer communities to thrive.

The Outreach Coordinator is responsible for supporting the growth and expansion of programs by identifying and engaging prospective eligible groups. This role focuses on executing outreach strategies, managing lead pipelines, and coordinating promotional activities to generate new client interest and support program enrollment. Working closely with Business Development and the Program Manager, the Outreach Coordinator ensures a consistent and professional outreach approach across all channels, including email, phone, events, and informational sessions.

This role plays a key part in building awareness of the program, developing outreach materials, tracking engagement metrics, and maintaining accurate CRM records to support effective pipeline management and conversion efforts.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Research and identify prospective eligible programs/groups.
  • Build and execute multi-touch outreach campaigns across email, phone, events, landing pages, social media, and outbound sequences (using CRM/marketing platforms such as HubSpot or Airtables to generate and qualify new client leads.
  • Coordinate conference presence, webinars, and informational sessions to promote the program.
  • Manage the prospect pipeline and CRM records — including lead scoring, enrichment, contact database maintenance, workflow triggers, and CRM syncs — to ensure accurate lead flow and attribution.
  • Develop outreach collateral and campaign assets — email templates, landing pages, talking points, and program summaries — tailored to specific segments, industries, or buyer personas, partnering with Content, Creative, and Digital Marketing teams as needed.
  • Track and report on outreach and campaign performance metrics (contacts made, open/click-through rates, conversion rates, cost per lead, pipeline volume) and recommend adjustments based on performance trends.
  • Conduct A/B and multivariate testing (subject lines, copy, CTAs, send times, segmentation) to optimize campaign performance.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Product Marketing, Content, and Revenue Operations teams to align messaging, timing, campaign goals, and ensure consistent systems integration and reporting.
  • Collaborate with Account Managers to ensure warm handoffs for newly converted clients.

EDUCATION:

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 2-5+ years of experience in digital marketing, demand generation, or marketing operations—preferably in a SaaS or EdTech environment.
  • Experience using marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, or similar.
  • Experience with PLG funnels, lead scoring models, and buyer journey alignment preferred.

COMPETENCIES – SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE/ABILITIES:

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills — able to engage a wide range of stakeholders professionally and persuasively, and collaborate effectively across distributed teams.
  • Highly organized with strong time-management skills — able to manage multiple outreach campaigns or projects simultaneously with attention to detail.
  • Proficiency managing outreach pipelines and CRM records (e.g., HubSpot, Creatio, or equivalent), with working familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite and marketing/outreach tools such as Apollo.io, Canva, and Google Analytics.
  • Proficiency in campaign-building workflows and audience segmentation.
  • Ability to analyze outreach and marketing metrics/funnel KPIs, and adjust strategies to improve engagement and conversion rates.
  • Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS for email and landing page formatting.
  • Comfort coordinating events such as webinars, conferences, and informational sessions, including logistics and follow-up activities.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with Account Managers and Program leadership to ensure smooth client transitions and alignment on messaging.

About Us:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

About SpendHound:

SpendHound is a software vendor management platform and benchmarking service launched by YipitData. We’ve experienced explosive growth by re-defining the business model for this category. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)

  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
    • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
    • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
    • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
    • Advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Software and AI benchmarks across more than 10,000 vendors to help negotiate better rates across vendors
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.

Why You Should Apply NOW:

We’ve grown from 40 customers to over 1000 customers and have expanded from a single point solution to a multi-modal platform in 2 years.

As we continue to scale, Outsourced Finance partnerships are becoming a critical part of our go-to-market strategy. We are seeking a Channel Sales Manager to own and grow our strategic relationships with outsourced finance partners and drive revenue through these partnership channels.

About The Role:

In this role, you’ll have a unique opportunity to help scale the Outsourced Finance partner motion. You will act as the central point of contact for our finance partner ecosystem and play a key role in driving both partner engagement and sales outcomes.

Your goal is to build and manage relationships that drive consistent partner-sourced opportunities, resulting in new SpendHound customers.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarter is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding.

As a Partnerships Manager, You Will:

  • Serve as the primary relationship manager for an initial portfolio of ~5 outsourced finance partner companies that we expect to grow to 10-20 over the coming months
  • Build strong communication channels with partners, ensuring alignment on priorities, objectives, and performance expectations.
  • Help grow the channel through targeted business development via referrals and cold outreach
  • Own customer targets tied to partner-sourced opportunities, including forecasting, pipeline tracking, and achievement of monthly/annual goals.
  • Help define the playbook to scale this motion across many possible partners.
  • Develop and manage joint go-to-market strategies with partners to drive mutual value and accelerate customer acquisition, including scalable processes and playbooks for partner enablement, co-marketing, and referral workflows.
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success) to enable partners with the tools, training, and information needed to succeed.
  • Monitor partner performance, report key metrics, and implement initiatives that improve outcomes for both partners and the company.
  • Act as an advocate for partners internally, ensuring feedback loops for continuous improvement.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Enjoy scaling new programs from the ground up and are comfortable experimenting and navigating ambiguity
  • Are a strong communicator with the executive presence to engage senior leaders and represent SpendHound externally
  • Results-oriented with proven success in meeting sales targets through indirect channels.
  • Thrive in fast-paced, cross-functional environments and know how to keep momentum moving across teams
  • Are proactive, self-directed, and take ownership without waiting for permission
  • Have 3-5 years of experience in partner/channel sales, alliances, or business development roles in a tech or services business.

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by your impact, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.

The on-target-earning for this position is anticipated to be $150,000 USD ($100,000 Base + $50,000 Uncapped Bonus). The final offer may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal team benchmarks. The compensation package also includes equity.

This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. Income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.

Please note that for this position, we are not able to consider candidates who currently or in the future will require visa sponsorship.

About Ethos

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Senior Director of Analytics for the Third-Party Agent Business — the primary analytics and data science voice helping the leadership team of this business decide where to focus, what’s working, and what to build next. You’ll lead and grow the analytics team, set the strategic agenda, and make sure data and insight sit at the center of every important decision we make. Our third-party agent business is one of Ethos’s most exciting growth engines. Our agent platform enables thousands of agencies and tens of thousands of agents to serve customers with fast, instant life insurance and a world-class agent experience — replacing a 9-week, paper-heavy process with a 3-day cash cycle on Ethos. Agents on our platform multiply their earnings by selling more, getting paid faster, and offering their customers a broader portfolio of products. The business is scaling fast across Term Life, IUL, Whole Life, and beyond.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Business analytics & strategy. Define and quantify the levers that drive the business across the agent journey — sourcing, onboarding, activation, productivity, and retention. Frame the right questions for leadership and answer them with rigor.
  • Agent product analytics & feature testing. Stand up a sharp, repeatable testing and measurement cadence on the agent product. Bring rigor to feature development through experimentation, instrumentation, funnel diagnostics, and causal analysis.
  • Core data foundations. Own the foundation everything else depends on: how we accurately calculate and pay agent commissions, calculate and resolve debt, measure retention, and attribute lifecycle activity. One source of truth, across the business.
  • AI-powered analytics. Set the vision for how the team uses AI to automate insight generation, focus humans on the highest-leverage work, and dramatically expand self-serve analytics. We expect to be on the cutting edge here.
  • Team. Inherit and grow the analytics organization. Set the bar on hiring, performance, and craft. Build a team that other parts of Ethos want to learn from.
  • Cross-functional partnership. Be an excellent partner to product, engineering, sales, operations, marketing, and finance — connecting dots across the business and turning insight into action.
  • DTC annuities support. Support our growing direct-to-consumer annuities business with tracking, sales-funnel analytics, re-engagement experimentation, and a healthy A/B testing cadence.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • An experienced leader. 10+ years in analytics, with 5+ years building and leading teams of managers and ICs.
  • A first-principles problem solver. You can take an unfamiliar business question and break it down to the structures, data, and decisions that actually matter. This is the single most important attribute we’re hiring for.
  • Hungry, driven, and proactive. You bring extreme drive and passion to discovering insight. You move fast, give answers, and push the business forward. You set the agenda — you don’t wait to be told what to do.
  • Strong business analytics, with solid product analytics fluency. Equally comfortable framing a strategy question, structuring the analysis, and writing the SQL. Skilled in experimentation, causal inference, and instrumentation.
  • A foundations builder. Track record of fixing definitions, dictionaries, taxonomies, and data quality problems at scale.
  • An excellent communicator. You present clearly to executives, write a sharp memo, and partner deeply with engineering on data modeling.
  • B2B2C experience preferred. You’ve analyzed performance across enterprise accounts, small businesses, agents, uplines, and end consumers all at once. Fintech, marketplaces, real estate tech, and insurance are all relevant; no specific domain required.

This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.

Department:Recruiter Screening - Operations

Location: India (Remote)

Work Schedule: 9 hours per day, 6 days per week

Employment Type: 6-Month Contract (High performance converts to an Extension or Full-time)

Compensation: ₹20,000 – ₹30,000 / month fixed + additional performance-based incentive

🚀 Why Join Weekday?

At Weekday, we are building the future of startup hiring. High-growth tech companies and fast-paced startups rely on us to find exceptional talent, fast.

As a Talent Operations Associate Intern, you will be on the front lines evaluating top-tier talent, conducting research on cutting-edge roles, and running the evaluation engine that connects great candidates with world-class tech companies.

If you are early in your career and looking for a fast-tracked growth opportunity into talent acquisition, startup operations, or people management, this is your launching pad.

💡 What You’ll Do (Your Impact)

  • Conduct High-Impact Candidate Screenings: Lead intro & evaluation calls with candidates to assess their technical/non-technical fit against client company requirements.

  • Deep-Dive Role Research: Research client roles upfront so you can lead engage-and-answer discussions and guide candidates authoritatively through the process.

  • Capture Rigorous Data & Evaluation: Collect comprehensive candidate insights covering structured rubric points to ensure candidates meet client interview standards.

  • Manage Candidate Experience & Feedback: Own candidate communication from end to end, managing feedback loops, status updates, and handoffs to Account Managers.

  • Master Talent Operations Tools: Leverage modern recruiting and operational software (Airtable, Slack, CRM tools) to deliver accurate reporting and maintain high quality standards.

🎯 Who You Are

We are looking for self-starters who are eager to learn and execute with excellence. You will thrive in this role if you are:

  • An Early Career Professional or Fresh Graduate: You have 0–1 years of experience (Graduates in BBA, Psychology, Engineering, or related fields are highly encouraged to apply!).

  • An Exceptional Communicator: You possess fluent written and spoken English skills with the confidence to lead candidate calls professionally.

  • A Fast Learner & Research-Minded: You can quickly grasp job descriptions across technical and non-technical domains and synthesize information quickly.

  • Coachable & Action-Oriented: You absorb feedback rapidly, adapt to fast-changing environments, and enjoy hitting daily operational goals.

Bonus points if you have experience with Airtable/Slack or a strong interest in startup hiring!


📈 What Your First 90 Days Look Like

  • First 15 Days (Onboard & Learn): Shadow live screening calls, master internal documentation tools, begin independently conducting 15–20 screening calls/day and progressively ramp up screening volume (target: 25–40 calls/day).

  • Days 30–60 (Own & Execute): Run independent, high-quality candidate screens that closely mirror client interview standards, take ownership of candidate feedback, and generate key reports.

  • Towards 6 Months (Scale & Convert): Master end-to-end talent operations and position yourself for full-time conversion or extension based on performance.

🎁 What’s In It For You?

  • Competitive Compensation: ₹20,000 – ₹30,000 per month base pay and additional performance based incentives.

  • Direct Path to Full-Time: Outstanding performance directly opens doors for extension of contract or conversion to full-time.

  • Steep Learning Curve: Learn startup hiring, candidate evaluation, and operational analytics directly from experienced leaders.

  • Culture of Growth: Work in a high-energy environment where taking ownership is recognized and rewarded.

📋 The Hiring Process

We respect your time and keep our process fast and transparent:

  1. Recruiter Screen (20 mins): Intro call to discuss your goals, background, and alignment.

  2. Hiring Manager Screen & Live Mock Call (30–45 mins): Practical assessment to showcase your research mindset, communication clarity, and coachability with Meghana, who this role will be reporting to.

  3. Culture Check: (20 mins): Alignment on values, motivation, and growth, with Sanjay, who is our Co-founder & COO.

raw.description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

The Director of Strategic Partnerships & Development leads ISTH's efforts to build and diversify non-dues revenue in service of the Society's mission to advance the understanding, prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of thrombotic and bleeding disorders worldwide. Reporting to the Executive Director & CEO, the Director will design and build ISTH's strategic partnerships and development function from the ground up, spanning corporate and industry partnerships, sponsorship, education and research support, and institutional giving. The Director will cultivate durable, mission-aligned relationships across a global partner community while establishing a sustainable foundation for long-term growth.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategy & Revenue Diversification

  • Develop and lead ISTH's strategic partnerships and revenue-diversification strategy, reducing concentration risk across partners, sectors, and revenue types.
  • Analyze the current revenue mix, benchmark against peer international societies, and set measurable growth and diversification targets.
  • Build a balanced portfolio of revenue streams impacting areas across annual congress, education, research, policy and awareness, institutional giving.

Corporate & Industry Partnerships

  • Design and launch a tiered Strategic Partner Program that converts episodic sponsorships into multi-year, year-round relationships.
  • Cultivate, negotiate, and steward partnerships across pharmaceutical, diagnostics, medical device, and digital-health sectors.
  • Serve as the senior relationship owner for ISTH's largest corporate partners, engaging in medical-affairs, commercial, and foundation counterparts.

Institutional Giving & Development

  • Establish a funding pillar including research and fellowship funds, foundation grants, and institutional giving that diversifies beyond corporate support.
  • Partner with foundations, and intergovernmental/NGO funders (e.g., WHO) on global health and LMIC-access programs.

Grant Writing & Proposal Development

  • Lead the development of high-quality grant proposals, letters of inquiry, and funding applications to foundations, corporate foundations, and other funders in support of ISTH's research, education, awareness, and global-health priorities.
  • Translate ISTH initiatives — fellowships, research funds, LMIC-access programs, and priority strategic initiatives — into fundable proposals tailored to each funder's mission, guidelines, and reporting expectations.
  • Manage the full grants lifecycle: funder prospecting and cultivation, proposal and budget development submission, and post-award stewardship and reporting, in partnership with internal departments.
  • Partner with program and scientific staff to source proposal content while preserving the scientific-independence firewall for funder-supported programs.

Congress Events & Sponsorships

  • Develop and maximize Congress-related partnership and sponsorship opportunities, including exhibition, industry-supported symposia, digital and hybrid placements, in close collaboration with the Meetings & Events team.
  • Develop year-round partnership opportunities around World Thrombosis Day, the Women's Health Initiative, and other mission-aligned platforms in collaboration with public affairs, marketing, education, and other relevant teams.

Compliance, Ethics & Scientific Independence

  • Uphold and operationalize the scientific-independence firewall so that no funder influences SSC standards, guidelines/guidance, editorial decisions, or the scientific program.
  • Ensure all relationships comply with the strictest applicable global transparency and disclosure regimes.
  • Develop and apply grant-acceptance and partner-vetting policies, escalating edge cases through the appropriate governance channels.

Team Leadership & Operations

  • Build and lead the Strategic Partnerships team through a phased approach aligned with revenue growth and organizational priorities; set goals, coach, and develop staff.
  • Stand up the function's infrastructure — database, partnership prospectus and rate card, contract and approval workflows, and reporting dashboards.
  • Own pipeline discipline, forecasting, and impact reporting with support from finance team; ensure relationships are held institutionally.

Knowledge & Skill Requirements

The Director of Strategic Partnerships & Business Development will be a seasoned leader with demonstrated success in strategic leadership, organizational management, and partnership development. This person will combine:

  • Advanced degrees or a scientific/clinical background required.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in partnerships, innovative programming, grants, including relationship ownership.
  • Demonstrated success building and diversifying non-dues or grants revenue and converting transactional sponsorships into multi-year partnerships.
  • International/global experience and cultural fluency.
  • Fluency in healthcare funder and industry relations and the compliance environment governing industry–society relationships.
  • Experience building teams, systems, and pipelines from an early state.
  • Exceptional relationship-building, negotiation, and written/verbal communication skills.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic acumen — sees the whole revenue portfolio and builds durable value, not one-off wins.
  • Ethical judgment & mission alignment — protects Society’s independence and reputation as the first consideration in every deal.
  • Relationship cultivation & stewardship — builds trust with senior partners and turns relationships into long-term, institutional commitments.
  • Global mindset & cultural competence — works fluently across regions, cultures, and markets in a truly international organization.
  • Financial literacy & data-driven decision-making — sets targets, reads the numbers, and manages a pipeline with rigor and transparency.
  • Team leadership & collaboration — builds and develops a team and collaborates across a matrixed, volunteer-led organization.

ISTH CORE VALUES

The ideal candidate will actively embody ISTH's core values in all aspects of leadership and decision-making.

  • Trust – Demonstrated integrity, transparency, and consistency in all dealings
  • Collaboration – Valuing diverse perspectives and partnering effectively with volunteer leadership and stakeholders
  • Respect – Inclusive leadership and thoughtful engagement across disciplines, regions, and backgrounds
  • Clear Communication – Timely, honest, accessible communication that ensures alignment and accountability
  • Progress – Embracing innovation, data-informed decision-making, and thoughtful improvement
  • Recognition – Cultivating a supportive culture that values contributions and strengthens connections within a global, distributed team

Employment Term

This position is offered as an initial three-year term. At the conclusion of the term, there may be an opportunity to transition the position to a permanent role, continue the position as structured, or adjust its scope, responsibilities, or structure to align with and best support the evolving needs and strategic priories of the organization.

Work Environment

  • This position is primarily sedentary, but may require the ability to lift and carry up to 30 lbs. of materials
  • Weekend and after-hour work may be required as dictated by the event schedule
  • Travel may be required for up to 5–20% of the work schedule
  • This position is eligible for remote work

Equal Opportunity

ISTH is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer committed to building an internationally diverse and inclusive workforce. ISTH does not discriminate in employment based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic. Qualified individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply; ISTH will provide reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process and employment.

Salary: $195,000 - $205,000 Annually

Expert Configuration Engineer

Location: Pune – Remote / Hybrid


Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced Expert Configuration Engineer to support enterprise Configuration Management, CI/CD automation, DevSecOps integration, release engineering, and build/deployment modernization initiatives across large-scale healthcare products.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, CI/CD pipelines, automation scripting, installer technologies, and cloud infrastructure automation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage source control systems including Azure DevOps (TFVC/Git) and GitHub Enterprise.
  • Design, configure, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.
  • Support repository governance, branching strategies, PR policies, and release management processes.
  • Lead/support migration initiatives such as TFVC to GitHub migration and CI/CD modernization.
  • Integrate DevSecOps tools such as Checkmarx, Mend (WhiteSource), GitHub Advanced Security, and Dependabot into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Develop and maintain MSI/MSP/MSIX packages using InstallShield.
  • Automate build, deployment, and operational activities using PowerShell, YAML, and scripting tools.
  • Support Azure cloud infrastructure automation using Terraform, Azure DevOps Services, Azure Key Vault, and related technologies.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues related to source control, pipelines, deployments, packaging, and cloud environments.
  • Collaborate with Development, QA, Security, Hosting, and Release teams to improve delivery processes and automation.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong experience with Azure DevOps (Server & Services), GitHub Enterprise & GitHub Actions, and CI/CD pipeline implementation.
  • Good understanding of branching strategies, release management, repository governance, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Hands-on experience with PowerShell scripting, Terraform, Azure Cloud services, and Azure Key Vault.
  • Expertise in InstallShield MSI/MSP/MSIX packaging and deployment automation.
  • Experience integrating security tools such as Checkmarx, Mend (WhiteSource), GitHub Advanced Security, and Dependabot.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in enterprise healthcare or product-based environments.
  • Experience supporting large-scale build and release environments.
  • Exposure to migration and modernization initiatives (.NET upgrades, GitHub migration, CI/CD standardization).

Experience

8+ years of experience in Configuration Management / DevOps / Build & Release Engineering.

Overview

JadeClass Education Singapore Writing and Analysis courses provide enrichment education to bright students who already have a good command of the English language and are focusing on their written English with the goal of continuing their education abroad. Our students vary in age from 6-16 and are carefully screened for English level, behavior, and motivation. We focus on teaching concrete skills that will help students in their learning endeavors.

IMPORTANT: We will not consider your application without a video introduction!!!

Job Responsibilities

Our Writing and Analysis courses place one teacher with a group of up to eight students for a semester length course of study covering a topic such as story analysis, story writing, persuasive writing, narrative writing, analytical writing, and literature analysis.

Lesson materials are provided by our design team and are classroom-ready: all teachers have to do is review them and teach! Grading and student support outside of the classroom is provided by our in-house staff – everything from presentations and in-class activities to homework, tests and keys with standardized comments are created during the development process so that the course can be taught and supported independently of its creators.

  • Develop and deliver well-planned, engaging online classes in a 1 on 8 format
  • Create, test, and revise lesson materials conforming to JadeClass standards
  • Commit to developing a full course of 15 lessons

Applicant Requirements

  • Able to guarantee preparation for and attendance at each scheduled meeting

· Fun personality, talkative

  • Logical, able to explain concepts clearly and simply
  • A good imitator, able to emulate our style
  • Neat and professional appearance

· Positive attitude

  • Malleable, willing to change to meet standards
  • Perfect oral grammar and clear enunciation

Schedule

Development meetings can take place any day of the week online on the ClassIn (classin.com) platform between the hours of 08:00 and 20:00 UTC +8 (Singapore time). Lessons take place on the weekends during the fall and spring, and Monday-Saturday during the summer.

For the Summer 2026 semester, classes will run from early July through late August with classes meeting twice per week either on Monday and Thursday, or Wednesday and Saturday, between the hours of 08:30 and 20:30 Singapore time.

  • July-August: Mon, Thurs 08:30 – 20:30 (UTC+8)

Wed, Sat 08:30 – 20:30 (UTC+8)

Compensation

  • 360 USD per newly developed lesson – includes in-class materials as well as homework, grading keys, and supplementary materials
  • Teaching hours are paid separately – 75 USD per 90 minute lesson
  • Remuneration is through Wise (wise.com) between the 10th and the 12th of each month.

Technology Requirements

  • Fast & stable internet connection (³ 20 Mbps)
  • Modern, reliable computer (~10,000+ on www.cpubenchmark.net/cpu_list.php)

Application Process

If you are interested in applying, please send the following to us at :

· Your resume

  • A link to your introduction video (Vimeo, YouTube, Google, or other safe platforms). The video can be 1-2 minutes in length, telling us a bit about your education and teaching background. If you send us a video file instead of a link, please make sure it is smaller than 20MB.

· Where you saw our job posting

  • The name of the position for which you wish to apply

Please understand that due to the high volume of applications, we are only able to consider applicants who submit all the information listed above. Thank you for your interest in JadeClass Education!
